rows.name: Blackout
rows.effect: The lights go out: your opponent's next 3 turns are skipped entirely.

rows.name: The Culling
rows.effect: At the start of each of your next 2 turns, a random enemy piece other than the king is captured.

rows.name: Grand Conjunction
rows.effect: Every sign, sphere, and spirit aligns at once: all enemy pieces except the king are frozen for 2 of their turns, and none of your pieces can be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Ice Age
rows.effect: Every enemy piece other than the king freezes solid and cannot move for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Iron Legion
rows.effect: A relief force arrives: place a queen, a rook and a knight on empty squares in your half.

rows.name: Living God
rows.effect: One piece gains amazon movement and explosive captures for the game, and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 6 turns. An uncapturable piece may never capture the king itself.

rows.name: Mass Petrify
rows.effect: Every enemy queen, rook, knight and bishop turns to stone for your opponent's next 3 turns. A petrified piece may only shuffle one square.

rows.name: Queen's Apocalypse
rows.effect: Your queen wipes every enemy piece off the board except their king and queen, once. Requires a queen.

rows.name: Regicide
rows.effect: Your queen teleports to an empty square next to the enemy king (or the nearest empty square to it) and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns. Every enemy piece beside the king freezes for those 2 turns.

rows.name: Resurrection
rows.effect: Every piece your opponent has captured returns to the board, filling empty squares in your half from your back rank outward and spilling into the rest of the board if your half runs out of room.

rows.name: Second Coming
rows.effect: Summon a queen on an empty square in your half, and your whole army cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Titan Legion
rows.effect: Three of your pieces become amazons for the game, uncapturable for your opponent's next 5 turns.

rows.name: Ascendancy
rows.effect: For your next 3 turns every one of your pieces except the king moves and captures as an amazon (a queen that also leaps like a knight), and your king cannot be captured.

rows.name: Grand Army
rows.effect: A whole fresh army answers your call: a new queen, two rooks, two bishops and two knights appear on empty squares in your half, and every remaining empty square in your half fills with a new pawn. It spills onto the rest of the board only if your half runs out of room.

rows.name: Oblivion
rows.effect: Every one of your opponent's pieces except the king is destroyed, every piece you have ever lost returns to your half, and your whole army cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn. Only their lone king is left standing against your full force.

rows.name: Total War
rows.effect: Every enemy piece except the king is destroyed, a fresh force of a queen, two rooks, two bishops and two knights lands in your half, and your whole army cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

rows.name: Ancient Custom
rows.effect: The old law never expired: once, one of your pawns may capture an enemy pawn standing directly beside it en passant, as though it had just double-stepped. (Reaching your last rank this way promotes to a queen.)

rows.name: Divine Right
rows.effect: No peasant may slay a king: enemy pawns can never capture your king, for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Bishop's Blessing
rows.effect: The clergy is above the cavalry's reach: enemy knights can never capture your bishops, for the rest of the game.

rows.name: First Blood
rows.effect: The first capture you make in the game steals 10 seconds from your opponent's clock and adds them to yours. In untimed games it collects nothing.

rows.name: Postern Gate
rows.effect: An old side door swings open in the keep wall: your right to castle on both sides is restored, even if your king or rooks have already moved.

rows.name: Deep Breath
rows.effect: Free action: ignore your nerf for one move, used at the moment you choose.

rows.name: Extra Glance
rows.effect: See your opponent's nerf for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Holy Hell
rows.effect: Your pawns can never be captured en passant, for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Pawn Shield
rows.effect: One pawn cannot be captured for your opponent's next 4 turns.

rows.name: Peek
rows.effect: Gain one draft reroll.

rows.name: Reprieve
rows.effect: Suspend your nerf for your next 2 turns.

rows.name: Small Mercies
rows.effect: The next 2 times your opponent captures one of your pieces, your nerf is suspended for your next turn.

rows.name: Watchtower
rows.effect: The tower spots the cavalry a mile out: enemy knights cannot move into your half of the board for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Bubble Wrap
rows.effect: Shrink-wrap one of your own pieces: it cannot be captured for 3 turns, but it can only move for the last of them. Your king cannot be chosen.

rows.name: Pioneer's Banner
rows.effect: The next 3 times one of your pieces (your king excepted) crosses from your half into your opponent's half, it plants the banner: that piece cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

rows.name: Scarecrow
rows.effect: Prop a scarecrow on an empty square in your half: it stands there as one of your pawns but is rooted and can never move, for the rest of the game. It blocks lines for both sides and can be captured like any pawn.

rows.name: Heir Apparent
rows.effect: The line of succession is settled in advance: the first time your opponent captures one of your knights or bishops, your pawn nearest your home rank is knighted into that same kind of piece where it stands.

rows.name: Home Guard
rows.effect: The threshold is warded for good: no enemy piece may ever move onto your first rank. Your back rank stays yours, and no enemy pawn can promote on it.

rows.name: King's Shield
rows.effect: The king's own shieldbearer never falls first: your piece standing on the square directly in front of your king cannot be captured. Whichever piece holds that square is protected while it stays there.

rows.name: Shield Wall
rows.effect: Shoulder to shoulder they cannot be broken: any of your pawns that stands directly beside another of your pawns (on the next file over, same rank) cannot be captured. A lone pawn is on its own.

rows.name: Chill Guy
rows.effect: He's just a chill guy: every freeze and every walnut currently stuck to YOUR pieces melts off, and you take 1 extra move. A free action. Lowkey he doesn't even care.

rows.name: Defiance
rows.effect: Free action: suspend your nerf until your opponent's next capture, used at the moment you choose.

rows.name: Draft Insight
rows.effect: Your next draft is fated to offer tier 3 cards.

rows.name: Held Breath
rows.effect: Free action: suspend your nerf for your next 2 turns, used at the moment you choose.

rows.name: Hunter's Relief
rows.effect: Your next 2 captures each suspend your nerf for your next turn.

rows.name: Loosen the Leash
rows.effect: Each of your next 3 captures loosens the leash: your nerf is suspended for your following turn.

rows.name: Oracle's Eye
rows.effect: The oracle inhales the vapors and names a better price: your bank offer improves by one tier.

rows.name: Reinforce
rows.effect: One of your pieces cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Slack in the Chain
rows.effect: Suspend your nerf for your next 3 turns.

rows.name: Stream Sniper
rows.effect: You found their stream: see your opponent's nerf for the rest of the game, and your own next draft shows three cards to pick from.

rows.name: Third Eye
rows.effect: Your third eye opens onto what is still hidden: see your opponent's nerf for the rest of the game, and gain one draft reroll.

rows.name: Break the Nerf
rows.effect: Free action: break your nerf, suspending it for your next 3 turns, and take one extra move the moment it breaks.

rows.name: Bunker
rows.effect: Three squares in front of your king are barred to enemies for 4 turns.

rows.name: Ascetic's Bargain
rows.effect: Take a vow of refusal: your next draft is skipped outright. The draft after that shows three cards to pick from and rolls one tier higher.

rows.name: Hit and Run
rows.effect: The next time one of your pieces makes a capture, it strikes and slips straight back to the square it came from, dodging any reprisal. Once.

rows.name: Jester's Rule
rows.effect: The court demands variety: for your opponent's next 6 turns, they can never capture the same kind of piece their previous move just captured.

rows.name: Double Down
rows.effect: Push it all onto the next hand: your next draft shows three cards and you keep all three of them. In return, the draft after that is skipped.

rows.name: Field Knighting
rows.effect: Knighted on the battlefield, no cathedral required: choose one of your pawns that has advanced at least to the middle of the board (its fifth rank or beyond) and it becomes a knight where it stands.

rows.name: Forced March
rows.effect: Sound the double-quick: for your next 2 turns, any of your pawns may advance two squares in one move from wherever it stands (both squares ahead must be empty), not only from its starting rank. It cannot double-step onto the final rank.

rows.name: Praetorian
rows.effect: The guard never leaves her side: your queen cannot be captured while at least one of your knights or bishops stands on a square adjacent to her. Cut down her escort and the guard is gone.

rows.name: Underdog's Gambit
rows.effect: Desperation sharpens the rank and file: while you have fewer pieces than your opponent (kings aside), your pawns may also capture an enemy piece standing directly beside them, one square to the left or right. Draw level and they fight like pawns again.

rows.name: Grace Period
rows.effect: Suspend your nerf entirely for 4 turns.

rows.name: Half Measure
rows.effect: Cut your nerf to half strength: it is suspended on every other one of your next several turns.

rows.name: North Star
rows.effect: The fixed star steadies your hand: your next draft is fated to offer tier 4 cards.

rows.name: Piece Parole
rows.effect: Release one of your pieces on parole: it gains a lasting shield, and your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns.

rows.name: Phishing Email
rows.effect: You are the prince now: a spoofed email talks your opponent out of their secrets. Reveal their hidden nerf for the rest of the game, and peek at the cards in their next draft offer.

rows.name: Seelie Blessing
rows.effect: The bright court smiles on one of your pieces: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Snap Freeze
rows.effect: Freeze the piece that last moved for 2 of its turns.

rows.name: Timely Lull
rows.effect: Free action: a lull settles over the whole board: both players' nerfs are suspended for their next 3 turns, used at the moment you choose.

rows.name: Underdog's Grit
rows.effect: While you have fewer pieces than your opponent, your nerf is suspended.

rows.name: Foresight
rows.effect: See your opponent's nerf for the rest of the game, and your next draft rolls one tier higher.

rows.name: Adrenaline
rows.effect: Whenever your king is in check, your nerf is suspended for your next turn.

rows.name: Cornered King
rows.effect: Desperation teaches strange footwork: while you have fewer pieces than your opponent (kings aside), your king may also move like a knight. Lasts the rest of the game.

rows.name: Masquerade
rows.effect: Two of your pieces trade masks: choose two of your knights, bishops, rooks or queens of different kinds, and they swap types where they stand. Your material never changes, only where the powers live.

rows.name: Queen's Testament
rows.effect: Her will is already written: the first time your opponent captures your queen, up to two of your captured knights and bishops immediately return to empty squares nearest your home rank.

rows.name: Spoils of War
rows.effect: The finest piece you have captured from your opponent defects to your colors: place it on an empty square on your home rank. It leaves your opponent's revival pool for good. Queens defect first, then rooks, bishops, knights, pawns.

rows.name: Battlefield Commission
rows.effect: The deeper the hole, the higher the field promotion: if you have fewer pieces than your opponent (kings aside), your most advanced pawn is promoted where it stands - to a knight, or to a rook if you are outnumbered by four pieces or more. Used while you are not behind, the commission goes unsigned.

rows.name: Coronation Bonus
rows.effect: The crowning is worth a stolen hour: the first time one of your pawns promotes, you gain 30 seconds on your clock. In untimed games it grants nothing.

rows.name: Eleventh Hour
rows.effect: When the last of the line is nearly spent, help arrives: the first time your non-king pieces number three or fewer, your best captured piece returns to the empty square nearest your home rank.

rows.name: King's Road
rows.effect: One lane on the board is declared yours: choose a file, and for the rest of the game no enemy piece may stand on that file within your own half of the board. Your pieces travel it freely.

rows.name: Plunderer's Ledger
rows.effect: Every prize is entered in the ledger: each of your next 3 captures earns you one draft reroll to spend whenever you like.

rows.name: Royal Caper
rows.effect: A cornered king learns to vault: while your king is in check it may leap like a knight. The trick works twice, then the old bones remember their age.

rows.name: Counter-Nerf
rows.effect: The next 3 times your opponent captures one of your pieces, your nerf is suspended for your next turn.

rows.name: Extra Move
rows.effect: Take two moves in a row, once. You cannot capture the king on the bonus move: your opponent replies first.

rows.name: Recast
rows.effect: Gain an extra draft reroll, and your next draft rolls one tier higher.

rows.name: Respite
rows.effect: Suspend your nerf for your next 5 turns.

rows.name: Scout
rows.effect: Take both cards in your next draft instead of one, but spend one of your rerolls.

rows.name: Touch Grass
rows.effect: You step outside for your own good: add 30 seconds to your clock, and your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns.

rows.name: Omniscience
rows.effect: See your opponent's nerf for the rest of the game; your next draft shows three cards to pick from.

rows.name: Watermelon Rind
rows.effect: Duck behind the rind: every one of your pieces standing on your back two ranks cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns. Pieces further forward are outside the shell.

rows.name: Blood Duel
rows.effect: Call a duel of equals: choose one enemy knight, bishop or rook, then one of your own pieces of the same kind. Both are removed from the board. Both losses are real and feed both revival pools.

rows.name: Blood Price
rows.effect: The deck feeds on sacrifice: destroy one of your own pieces (your king excepted), and your next draft is fated to offer tier 6 cards.

rows.name: Deathless Oath
rows.effect: One of your pieces (your king excepted) swears the oath: the first time it is captured, it instantly returns to the empty square nearest your home rank. One rebirth, then the oath is spent.

rows.name: Diplomatic Immunity
rows.effect: Appoint one of your pieces (your king excepted) as an envoy: it cannot be captured while it stands in your opponent's half of the board, for the rest of the game. In your own half it is fair game.

rows.name: Deep Position
rows.effect: Break into their camp and the clock rewards the incursion: the first time any of your pieces reaches your opponent's back two ranks, you gain 45 seconds. In untimed games it grants nothing.

rows.name: Hallowed Ground
rows.effect: Consecrate one empty square in your half: no enemy piece may ever stand on it, and while your king is in check it may step there from anywhere on the board.

rows.name: Ironwright's Bargain
rows.effect: The forge takes iron and gives iron back heavier: one of your knights or bishops is reforged into a rook, and in payment one of your pawns is thrown into the fire and lost.

rows.name: Martyr's Gift
rows.effect: Every loss leaves you something: each of the next 3 times your opponent captures one of your pieces, you gain a draft reroll and 5 seconds on your clock.

rows.name: Tunnelers
rows.effect: It digs its own lines: choose one of your rooks, and for the rest of the game it may slide straight through your own pieces (never capturing them) to any empty square beyond.

rows.name: Watchword
rows.effect: A pawn's protection is absolute: any of your pieces (your king aside) that is defended by one of your pawns cannot be captured. Remove the pawn and the shelter goes with it.

rows.name: Iron Reign
rows.effect: Your king cannot be captured for 2 full turns.

rows.name: Iron Will
rows.effect: Whenever your opponent captures one of your pieces, your nerf is suspended for your next 2 turns.

rows.name: Long Leash
rows.effect: Suspend your nerf for your next 7 turns.

rows.name: Mass Resurrect
rows.effect: Revive any four captured pawns to empty squares on your 2nd rank.

rows.name: Parole
rows.effect: Your nerf is removed for good after your next 10 turns.

rows.name: Rehab
rows.effect: Check into rehab: your nerf is suspended permanently for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Total Freeze
rows.effect: Freeze every enemy piece except the king that stands on a square next to one of your pieces, for 1 turn.

rows.name: Warden's Bribe
rows.effect: Free action: suspend your nerf for your next 6 turns, used at the moment you choose.

rows.name: Aegis
rows.effect: Every one of your pieces except your king cannot be captured for 1 full turn.

rows.name: Alchemist's Trade
rows.effect: Equivalent exchange: one of your knights, bishops or rooks is transmuted into a queen; in payment, another of your knights, bishops, rooks or queens crumbles into a pawn where it stands (it cannot be standing on a first or last rank).

rows.name: Early Coronation
rows.effect: The heralds cannot wait: for your next 3 turns, any pawn move of yours that reaches your opponent's third of the board (their back three ranks) may promote to a queen on the spot.

rows.name: Highwayman's Toll
rows.effect: Stand and deliver: your next 3 captures each steal 8 seconds from your opponent's clock and add them to yours. In untimed games the toll collects nothing.

rows.name: Prisoner Exchange
rows.effect: Envoys meet at the river: the finest captured piece of EACH side returns to the board at once, each placed on the empty square nearest its own home rank (queens first, then rooks, bishops, knights, pawns). Your opponent's piece comes back too, so trade wisely.

rows.name: Standard Bearer
rows.effect: One of your pawns takes up the army's standard: for the rest of the game it may also move like a queen, but never capture that way, and never onto a first or last rank. Its humble pawn captures remain.

rows.name: Castle in the Storm
rows.effect: Throw up the walls mid-battle: choose one of your rooks on your king's rank with an empty path to the king, and castle toward it at once (king two squares over, rook to the square it passed) even if your king or that rook has already moved.

rows.name: Funeral Pyre
rows.effect: Light one of your own and let it take the neighbors with it: choose any of your pieces (your king aside). It is removed, and every enemy piece on a square adjacent to it is destroyed in the blast. Shielded enemies and enemy kings survive.

rows.name: Last Muster
rows.effect: Call up whoever is left in the village: place up to 3 pawns on empty squares in your half. They hold the line, then disband four of your turns later, vanishing from the board.

rows.name: Rally to the King
rows.effect: Call the nearest blade home: teleport any one of your pieces (your king aside) to an empty square directly adjacent to your king.

rows.name: Second Face
rows.effect: It learns a second way to move: choose one of your bishops, and for the rest of the game it may also leap like a knight, keeping all of its bishop moves as well.

rows.name: Vantage Point
rows.effect: Dig in on the heights and they cannot dislodge you: any of your pieces (your king aside) standing on your opponent's back two ranks cannot be captured. Step back off the heights and it is fair game again.

rows.name: Chess Diff
rows.effect: Chess diff! The game is paused and a fresh, completely normal game of 1+0 chess is played on a clean board: no drafts, no cards, no powers of any kind. Whoever WINS the diff seizes an apex (tier 9) buff, then the paused game (board and clocks) resumes.

rows.name: Nerf Breaker
rows.effect: Remove your nerf entirely for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Bolt Hole
rows.effect: Old castles keep old secrets: while your king is in check, it may escape through the walls to any empty square within 2 squares of where it stands. The passage bears 2 such escapes, then collapses.

rows.name: Carnival of Masks
rows.effect: Ring the carnival bell: every one of your pieces except your king puts on another's mask. Their types are shuffled among their squares at random. The army keeps exactly the same pieces, but nobody is where their powers say they are. Pawns never land on a first or last rank.

rows.name: Kingmaker's Pact
rows.effect: Sign with the power behind every throne: every one of your future drafts rolls one tier higher, for the rest of the game. In exchange you forfeit ALL of your draft rerolls, now and forever. The hand you are dealt is the hand you play.

rows.name: Restitution
rows.effect: The scales demand balance: for every kind of piece where your opponent outnumbers you on the board, one of your captured pieces of that kind returns to the empty square nearest your home rank. Played from ahead, it restores nothing.

rows.name: From the Ashes
rows.effect: The dead are called back only far enough to make it even: your captured pieces return one at a time to your home rank, strongest first, until your non-king pieces number exactly as many as your opponent's. From ahead or level, nobody rises.

rows.name: Futures Market
rows.effect: Mortgage the near future for one shot at the very top: your next 2 drafts are skipped, and the draft that follows them deals a rare apex-tier offer, letting you take one of two apex cards.

rows.name: High Stakes
rows.effect: Sweep the table twice: you keep every card offered in each of your next 2 drafts instead of just one. In return you forfeit all of your rerolls, now and forever.

rows.name: King's Sanctuary
rows.effect: Spirit the king home to the quietest corner: your king is moved to the empty square on your home rank that sits furthest from any enemy piece, and it cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

rows.name: Kingsguard Duel
rows.effect: Honor demands the guards settle it: remove one enemy piece standing beside your opponent's king, and in payment remove one of your own pieces standing beside your king. Both monarchs are left a little more exposed.

rows.name: Last Stand
rows.effect: Raise the shield wall around everything and pay for it later: for the next 3 turns none of your pieces can be captured and your king cannot be taken. The smiths take their due up front - your next 3 drafts are skipped.

rows.name: Martyrdom
rows.effect: One of yours falls so two of theirs must: destroy one of your own knights or bishops, then remove any two of your opponent's knights or bishops from the board. Every loss here is real.

rows.name: Mummers' Dance
rows.effect: The masks come round and everyone swaps: every one of your knights becomes a bishop and every one of your bishops becomes a knight, all at once, where they stand. Your material is unchanged, only re-tasked. While the troupe is changing costume, none of the re-tasked minors can be captured on your opponent's next turn.

rows.name: Checkmate Denial
rows.effect: Your king cannot be captured for the next 5 turns.

rows.name: Fortress Realm
rows.effect: A 3x3 zone you pick makes your pieces there, your king aside, uncapturable for your opponent's next 5 turns.

rows.name: Full Pardon
rows.effect: Remove your nerf for good and take an extra move on your next turn. You cannot capture the king on the bonus move: your opponent replies first.

rows.name: Nerf Reversal
rows.effect: Turn your nerf against itself: remove it for good, and your whole army cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Sabbatical
rows.effect: Suspend your nerf for your next 10 turns.

rows.name: Unshackled Wrath
rows.effect: Remove your nerf for good. Your opponent skips their next turn.

rows.name: Absolute Aegis
rows.effect: Every one of your pieces cannot be captured for 2 full turns, and this time that includes your king.

rows.name: The Eternal Keep
rows.effect: Your home rank is raised into a fortress that never falls: your pieces standing on your first rank (your king excepted) can never be captured, for the rest of the game. Step off the rampart, and the stone no longer knows you.

rows.name: The Great Return
rows.effect: The gates of the underworld open both ways: every captured piece of BOTH sides still owed to the board returns at once, each placed on empty squares nearest its own home rank. The side that has lost more, regains more.

rows.name: The Long Truce
rows.effect: Heralds cross the field and every blade is lowered: for 2 full turns, no piece on EITHER side can be captured, kings included. While the truce holds you breathe freely: your own nerf is suspended for your next 4 turns.

rows.name: Shadow Reserve
rows.effect: Open the coat: a knight, a bishop and a rook slip into your pocket, ready to be dropped onto empty squares on later turns (each drop spends that turn). The smugglers take their fee up front: your next 2 drafts are skipped outright.

rows.name: Covenant of Return
rows.effect: Swear the covenant and death loses its next three arguments: the next 3 of your pieces that are captured each return at once to the empty square nearest your home rank.

rows.name: Drive Them Out
rows.effect: Clear the homeland and let the invaders regret the crossing: every enemy piece standing in your half of the board is removed, and every one of your own pieces standing in your opponent's half is removed with them. Both kings are spared.

rows.name: Pretender to the Throne
rows.effect: Crown a claimant out of thin air: a brand new queen strides onto an empty square on your home rank. The court is not cheap - your next 3 drafts are skipped and you forfeit all of your rerolls.

rows.name: The Homecoming
rows.effect: The veterans are called back to the colors: your best captured major (a queen, or else a rook) and your best captured minor (a bishop, or else a knight) both return to empty squares nearest your home rank. The muster costs you your next 2 drafts.

rows.name: The Reckoning
rows.effect: Call in every debt the minor pieces owe: every knight and every bishop on the board, yours and your opponent's alike, is removed at once. Kings, queens, rooks and pawns are untouched.

rows.name: Turn the Tide
rows.effect: The whole line surges as one: every one of your pawns that can advance takes one step forward at once, wherever the square ahead is empty. Pawns that would reach the final rank hold their ground.

rows.name: Transcendence
rows.effect: Remove your nerf for good. Your next draft shows three cards.

rows.name: Bishop Polish
rows.effect: One bishop can jump exactly one piece, once.

rows.name: Castle Early
rows.effect: Castle even if your king has already moved once.

rows.name: Cornerstone
rows.effect: Your rooks cannot be captured while on their starting squares.

rows.name: Diagonal Step
rows.effect: Your king moves like a bishop for one move.

rows.name: Escape Hatch
rows.effect: Your king swaps places with one of its own pawns, once.

rows.name: Ferz King
rows.effect: Your king may move two squares diagonally, once per game.

rows.name: Firm Footing
rows.effect: Choose one piece: it and your pawns on the squares beside it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Free Retreat
rows.effect: Return your last-moved piece to the square it came from, once.

rows.name: Guarded King
rows.effect: Enemy pieces cannot move to the squares diagonally adjacent to your king for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Half Step
rows.effect: One pawn moves diagonally forward without capturing, once.

rows.name: I Hate My Ex
rows.effect: Freeze one enemy pawn for 2 turns, but you get so worked up you freeze your own nearest pawn for 2 turns too. Mostly self-inflicted.

rows.name: Little Leap
rows.effect: One pawn jumps a single blocking piece directly ahead, once.

rows.name: Tight Formation
rows.effect: Pawns still standing on your second rank cannot be captured, for the game. Once a pawn steps forward it is on its own.

rows.name: Loyal Pawn
rows.effect: One pawn promotes on your 7th rank instead of your 8th.

rows.name: Nudge
rows.effect: Push one enemy pawn back one square if empty behind, once.

rows.name: Prep
rows.effect: Your next buff draft shows three cards to pick from instead of two, once.

rows.name: Quick Glance
rows.effect: Your opponent loses one draft reroll, if they still hold one.

rows.name: Quiet March
rows.effect: One pawn can move backward one square, once.

rows.name: Rook Slide
rows.effect: One rook moves one square diagonally, once.

rows.name: Second Wind
rows.effect: One captured pawn returns to an empty square on your 2nd rank, once.

rows.name: Sentinel Pawn
rows.effect: One pawn may capture an enemy piece two squares diagonally ahead, once.

rows.name: Sidestep
rows.effect: Choose one piece: it steps one square to an empty square beside it and cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

rows.name: Steady Hand
rows.effect: Enemy knights cannot move to squares that attack your king for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Steady March
rows.effect: Two pawns each advance one square immediately.

rows.name: Tempo Shuffle
rows.effect: Move one pawn sideways one square, once.

rows.name: Updraft
rows.effect: One knight may make a longer 3-by-1 leap, once.

rows.name: Anchor
rows.effect: One piece cannot be pushed or swapped by enemy buffs, for the game.

rows.name: Bulwark
rows.effect: Two pawns in front of your king cannot be captured for 3 turns.

rows.name: Camel Knight
rows.effect: One knight also moves as a camel (3-1 leap), for the game.

rows.name: Counterstep
rows.effect: After your opponent's next capture, you take two moves in reply, once. You cannot capture the king on the bonus move: your opponent replies first.

rows.name: Decoy
rows.effect: Summon a decoy on an empty square in your half, and your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Battering Line
rows.effect: Your pawns can capture straight ahead for your next 2 turns.

rows.name: Emotional Support Pawn
rows.effect: A small round friend refuses to leave your side: place a new pawn on an empty square right beside your king.

rows.name: Fork Guard
rows.effect: Whenever one of your knights gives check, it cannot be captured on the reply turn.

rows.name: Ghost Pawn
rows.effect: One pawn may advance two squares by passing through a single enemy piece directly ahead of it, landing on the empty square beyond without capturing, once.

rows.name: Imp Familiar
rows.effect: A smug little imp perches on an empty square of your back rank and fights as a bishop for 3 of your turns, then scampers back through the veil.

rows.name: King's Guard
rows.effect: Add a pawn to your pocket, then spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square.

rows.name: Long Castle Anywhere
rows.effect: Regain castling rights, and queenside castling ignores the b-file square.

rows.name: Long Knight
rows.effect: One knight makes two knight-leaps in a single move, once.

rows.name: Mind Nudge
rows.effect: Force one enemy pawn to advance one square where empty, once.

rows.name: Minor Recall
rows.effect: Return a captured knight or bishop to your back rank, once.

rows.name: Onett
rows.effect: A townsperson reports for duty: a new pawn takes the nearest open square on your pawn line, or just ahead of it if the line is packed.

rows.name: Pawn Push
rows.effect: On any turn, one of your pawns with two empty squares ahead may advance two squares in a single move, even after it has left its starting square, for the game.

rows.name: Pawn Storm
rows.effect: Every one of your pawns still on its starting square advances one square, if the square ahead is empty.

rows.name: Phase Rook
rows.effect: Choose one rook. For the game it may pass through one friendly piece per move; it still cannot capture friendly pieces or phase through two.

rows.name: Piece Swap
rows.effect: Swap positions of any two of your own pieces, once.

rows.name: Rally
rows.effect: One of your knights may move like a king for 1 turn.

rows.name: Recall
rows.effect: Return one piece to any empty square in your back two ranks, once.

rows.name: Reposition
rows.effect: Move one piece, your king included, one square in any direction to an empty square, once. It cannot capture.

rows.name: Screen
rows.effect: Choose one bishop. While it stands on a square next to your king it cannot be captured, for your next 3 turns.

rows.name: Shadow Step
rows.effect: One of your pieces slips through shadow to a nearby empty square and cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn, once.

rows.name: Shielded Advance
rows.effect: Choose one pawn. While it stands in the enemy half it cannot be captured, for your next 3 turns.

rows.name: Sidestep King
rows.effect: Your king cannot be captured for 1 turn.

rows.name: Slowpoke
rows.effect: A famously bad card. Your whole army goes sluggish: for your next turn every piece can move only one square. It shrugs, apologetically.

rows.name: Spring Pawn
rows.effect: Your pawns can spring one square sideways onto an empty square, twice.

rows.name: Summon Intern
rows.effect: The first time your opponent captures one of your pieces, the intern quietly takes over the empty desk: a pawn joins your pocket, to be dropped onto an empty square on a later turn.

rows.name: Teleport Knight
rows.effect: Move one knight to any empty square within the 3x3 box around it, once. It cannot capture with this move.

rows.name: Trade Up
rows.effect: The next time you lose a minor piece, a new pawn appears in your half.

rows.name: Undying Thrall
rows.effect: Bind a restless spirit into service: one of your captured knights or bishops claws back onto an empty square of your back rank and fights for 5 of your turns, then crumbles to dust, once.

rows.name: Vault
rows.effect: One rook jumps its own pawn to the far side, once.

rows.name: 25 Inch Waist
rows.effect: Lean and nimble: each of your pawns may also slip diagonally forward one square onto empty ground, no capture needed, wiggling past the traffic.

rows.name: Wazir Bishop
rows.effect: Choose one bishop; for the game it may also step one square horizontally or vertically.

rows.name: Wazir Rook
rows.effect: Choose one rook; for the game it may also step one square diagonally.

rows.name: Kangaroo Hop
rows.effect: One of your knights takes a little kangaroo hop: it may also step one square in any direction, once.

rows.name: Cinder Strike
rows.effect: Remove one of your opponent's pawns from the board, once.

rows.name: Frost Nip
rows.effect: Frost nips at the rearguard: every enemy piece except the king still standing on its own back rank is frozen for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Regrow
rows.effect: One of your captured pawns sprouts back on your 4th rank, or the nearest rank with room, already pointed at promotion.

rows.name: Thunder Step
rows.effect: One rook may move up to two squares diagonally, once.

rows.name: Field Hospital
rows.effect: The first time your opponent captures one of your knights, a new pawn is raised on an empty square of your back rank.

rows.name: Pikemen
rows.effect: One of your pawns may also move and capture one square sideways, for the game.

rows.name: Reclaim the Fallen
rows.effect: Battlefield salvage: the next 2 enemy pawns you capture are pressed into service, joining your pocket to be dropped onto empty squares on later turns.

rows.name: Regroup the Lines
rows.effect: Sound the recall: every one of your pieces standing in the enemy half falls back one square toward home, wherever the square behind it is free.

rows.name: Banner of War
rows.effect: Raise the banner and your cavalry surges: for your next 3 turns each of your knights may also step one square in any direction like a king.

rows.name: Berolina Pawns
rows.effect: Your pawns may also step diagonally forward to empty squares and capture straight ahead, for the game.

rows.name: Bishop to Archbishop
rows.effect: One bishop also moves like a knight, for the game.

rows.name: Board Lock
rows.effect: The whole board seizes up: no enemy piece may travel more than 3 squares in a single move, for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Board Quake
rows.effect: Push every enemy pawn back one square where empty behind.

rows.name: Bodyguard
rows.effect: Add a knight to your pocket, then spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square.

rows.name: Cannon
rows.effect: Choose one rook. For the game it keeps its normal moves and may also capture along a rank or file by jumping exactly one piece of either color and taking the first enemy piece beyond it.

rows.name: Chain Mail
rows.effect: All your minor pieces are uncapturable for 2 full turns.

rows.name: Clone
rows.effect: Run one of your pawns through the photocopier: place an exact copy on an empty square within two squares of it, once.

rows.name: Scratch Card
rows.effect: Scratch off three panels with the edge of a coin. Match all three for a knight in your pocket. Match two for 30 seconds. Three blanks and the dud ticket costs you your weakest pawn.

rows.name: Ctrl+Z
rows.effect: Undo. One of your captured pawns, knights, or bishops returns to an empty square in your half, once.

rows.name: Deflect
rows.effect: Your queen cannot be captured for your opponent's next 4 turns.

rows.name: Dragon Pawn
rows.effect: One pawn moves as a pawn or knight until it promotes.

rows.name: Fortress
rows.effect: One piece standing next to your king becomes uncapturable for your opponent's next 4 turns. Your king itself is not shielded.

rows.name: Frost
rows.effect: Freeze two adjacent enemy pieces for 1 turn each.

rows.name: Glamour
rows.effect: The courts trade changelings: one enemy pawn you choose joins your army, and one of your pawns you choose joins theirs.

rows.name: Grasshopper
rows.effect: Choose one non-king piece. For the game it may also move along any rank, file, or diagonal and land on the square immediately beyond the first piece in its path, capturing an enemy piece that stands there.

rows.name: Guard Rotation
rows.effect: Swap your king with a rook anywhere on the board, once.

rows.name: Hallowed Return
rows.effect: A prayer is answered exactly: one of your captured knights, bishops, or rooks is restored to life on one of its own starting squares, if one is free, once.

rows.name: Handstand Pushup
rows.effect: Flip one pawn upside down. Forever it may also step and capture straight back or diagonally back toward your own side, but never onto its own back rank.

rows.name: I Love Smelling My GF's Hoodie
rows.effect: Wrap one of your pieces in the hoodie: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns. Warm, safe, faintly of her.

rows.name: Iron Bishop
rows.effect: One bishop cannot be captured by pawns, for the game.

rows.name: Jet Lag
rows.effect: Book your opponent a red-eye: their clock loses 20 seconds, and the next piece they move is left so groggy it must move again on the turn after. If that piece can no longer move, the repeat is skipped.

rows.name: Knight to Nightrook
rows.effect: One knight also slides straight up and down its file, any distance, for the game.

rows.name: Lag Spike
rows.effect: Their connection chooses violence: your opponent's clock loses 25 seconds.

rows.name: Legendary Forge
rows.effect: The forge mends what war broke: one of your captured knights or bishops is reforged and returns to your pocket. Spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square.

rows.name: Ley Line
rows.effect: You wake the old current sleeping under the board: one of your pieces rides it to any empty square on its own file, once.

rows.name: Momentum
rows.effect: After your next capture, immediately take a second move, once.

rows.name: Monkeytype
rows.effect: Type at full speed: relocate up to 3 of your pieces, each exactly one square, in a rapid burst of keystrokes. Kings sit this test out.

rows.name: Overclock
rows.effect: Your knights move like knights or kings for 3 turns.

rows.name: Overtime Whistle
rows.effect: Blow the whistle for overtime: add 30 seconds to your own clock.

rows.name: Phalanx
rows.effect: Your entire pawn line becomes uncapturable for 2 turns.

rows.name: Piece Steal
rows.effect: Convert one enemy pawn to your color, once.

rows.name: Pin Breaker
rows.effect: One of your pieces breaks free with a knight's leap to an empty square, once.

rows.name: Pixie Dust
rows.effect: A handful of glittering dust settles on your stables: for your next 3 turns each of your knights may also step one square diagonally.

rows.name: Subscriber Raid
rows.effect: A fake donation alert blasts across the board and the raid pours in: add 20 seconds to your clock while your opponent loses 10 to the chaos.

rows.name: Promote Now
rows.effect: Instantly promote one of your pawns on your 6th rank or beyond to a queen.

rows.name: Purge Two
rows.effect: Remove one enemy pawn, and freeze every other enemy pawn for their next turn.

rows.name: Queen's Echo
rows.effect: Your rooks move like queens for your next 2 turns.

rows.name: Raise Dead
rows.effect: Speak the words of unmaking over enemy soil: one of your fallen pawns, knights, or bishops rises again on an empty square in your OPPONENT'S half of the board, once.

rows.name: Rank Runner
rows.effect: One pawn advances to any empty square on its file up to your 5th rank, once.

rows.name: Regenerate
rows.effect: Revive two of your captured pawns to empty squares on your 2nd rank.

rows.name: Rewind One
rows.effect: Undo the last two half-moves: send the last piece each side moved back to the square it came from, once.

rows.name: Rook to Chancellor
rows.effect: One rook also moves like a knight, for the game.

rows.name: Seance
rows.effect: The circle trades places with the beyond: send one of your knights or bishops across to the other side, and one of your captured rooks returns in its place, on the square that knight or bishop just vacated.

rows.name: Second Wind Major
rows.effect: Return a captured rook to any empty back-rank square, once.

rows.name: Sliding King
rows.effect: Your king moves like a king or bishop for 3 turns.

rows.name: Split Bishop
rows.effect: Add a new bishop to your pocket, then spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square.

rows.name: Split March
rows.effect: Four pawns each advance one square immediately.

rows.name: Summon Knight
rows.effect: Place a new knight on any empty square in your half, once.

rows.name: Supply Drop
rows.effect: A knight is airlifted into your reserves, and a crate of spares lands with it as a pawn. Later, spend turns to drop them onto empty squares.

rows.name: Tempo Theft
rows.effect: Steal your opponent's next turn (you move twice, they wait), once.

rows.name: Tidal Push
rows.effect: Shove one enemy piece two squares in a straight line if the path is empty, once.

rows.name: Time Skip
rows.effect: Your opponent skips their next turn, and the piece they last moved is frozen for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Vanguard
rows.effect: One pawn on your 6th rank or beyond promotes to a knight, once.

rows.name: Arcane Reroll
rows.effect: Gain a draft reroll.

rows.name: Banish
rows.effect: Banish one enemy pawn, knight, or bishop from the board, once.

rows.name: Blink
rows.effect: Your king blinks: it trades places with one of your knights, bishops, or rooks, once.

rows.name: Conjured Scout
rows.effect: Conjure a knight on an empty square on your back rank. It fights for 2 of your turns, then fades.

rows.name: Ghostwalk
rows.effect: One of your bishops may also step one square straight, like a rook, for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Sigil Ward
rows.effect: Choose one of your pieces: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns, and the first enemy piece to move up next to it in that time is frozen for its next 2 turns.

rows.name: Spectral Retinue
rows.effect: Your retinue turns spectral and re-forms: every one of your knights becomes a bishop, and every one of your bishops becomes a knight, where they stand.

rows.name: Phase Field
rows.effect: One of your bishops slips half out of the world: each move it may pass through a single piece of either color, for the game. It still cannot capture its own side.

rows.name: Suppress Magic
rows.effect: Your opponent's next draft offer contains no draft-manipulation cards, and the next buff they draft arrives nullified.

rows.name: Transmute
rows.effect: Turn one of your pawns into a knight, once.

rows.name: Wall
rows.effect: Raise a wall on one empty square you pick: enemy pieces can never move onto it, for the game.

rows.name: Warp Home
rows.effect: Teleport one of your pieces back to a vacant starting square of its own type, once. A rook warps to an empty a1 or h1, a knight to b1 or g1, a pawn to any open square on its second rank, and so on.

rows.name: Warp Step
rows.effect: Move one piece up to three squares in a straight line to an empty square, passing over any pieces in between, once. It cannot capture.

rows.name: Black Hole
rows.effect: Open a black hole on one empty square: any enemy piece that steps onto it, never a king, is swallowed off the board. It stays open for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Clumsy Dash
rows.effect: Bolt for it and fumble: take one extra move right now, but one of your pawns is dropped and frozen in place for your next 2 turns.

rows.name: Moonwalk
rows.effect: Teach your pawns to moonwalk: for your next 3 turns each of your pawns may also step one square straight backward onto an empty square.

rows.name: Red Tape
rows.effect: Bury your opponent in paperwork: they skip their next turn, but the forms catch up with you and you skip the turn after that.

rows.name: Sacrificial Bishop
rows.effect: Feed one of your bishops to the volcano to smite one enemy knight or bishop you name: both leave the board, once.

rows.name: Slip on Ice
rows.effect: Freeze one of your opponent's rooks in place for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Ball Lightning
rows.effect: Your next 2 captures each also destroy the enemy pieces (never a king) on the two squares immediately left and right of the captured square.

rows.name: Bramble Wall
rows.effect: Thorns snare the clergy: your opponent's bishops cannot move or capture for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Creeping Roots
rows.effect: Roots grip at the border: your opponent's pawns cannot cross into your half of the board for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Gale
rows.effect: A driving wind opens gaps: for your next 2 turns your bishops may each slip through one friendly piece in their way.

rows.name: River Flow
rows.effect: The board runs like water: for your next 2 turns your rooks may each slip through one friendly piece in their way.

rows.name: Seedlings
rows.effect: Plant two seeds on empty squares in your half: after 3 of your turns, a pawn sprouts on each square that is still empty.

rows.name: Static Field
rows.effect: Static builds on anything that runs: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any enemy piece except the king that travels 3 or more squares in one move is grounded, frozen for 1 turn where it lands.

rows.name: Stone Grip
rows.effect: Turn one enemy piece (never a king) to a walnut for 3 of their turns: it can only shuffle one square at a time. The enemy pieces directly beside it (up, down, left, or right) cannot capture for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Whirlpool
rows.effect: A whirlpool drags one enemy pawn to your side and deposits it on your 4th rank, yours now and ready to advance.

rows.name: Will-o'-Wisp
rows.effect: A cold flame dances ahead of one enemy piece and it follows: lure one enemy piece except a king one square diagonally forward, toward your side, onto an empty square you choose.

rows.name: Dragoons
rows.effect: One of your knights trains to vault the line: it may also jump exactly two squares straight in any direction, over anything, for the game.

rows.name: Flank March
rows.effect: For your next 3 turns, each of your bishops may also step one square straight in any direction.

rows.name: Forced Retreat
rows.effect: Push one enemy piece one square directly away from your king, if that square is empty, once. Kings cannot be pushed.

rows.name: Phalanx Advance
rows.effect: Shields lock across the whole front: enemy pawns can never capture your pawns, for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Pontoon Bridge
rows.effect: One of your rooks, bishops, or queens may pass through up to two of your own pieces on its move, once.

rows.name: Sapper Team
rows.effect: The sappers surface behind their lines: place a new pawn on an empty square in your opponent's half of the board.

rows.name: War Wagon
rows.effect: One of your bishops may also move up to two squares straight in any direction, for the game.

rows.name: Amazon Knight
rows.effect: One knight becomes a knight plus queen for 2 turns.

rows.name: Army Reversal
rows.effect: For your next 2 turns, each of your pawns may also move one square straight backward onto an empty square (no capture).

rows.name: Atomic Captures (Small)
rows.effect: Your captures clear enemy pieces on the two squares beside the captured piece.

rows.name: Ballerina Cappuccina
rows.effect: The coffee-cup ballerina leads a formation twirl: choose one of your pieces (not the king) to step one square, then up to two allies that stood beside it may each step one square too. No captures, just choreography.

rows.name: Battle Pass
rows.effect: Season rewards trickle in: at the end of each of your next 6 turns, your clock gains 10 seconds.

rows.name: Blink Army
rows.effect: Teleport two pawns forward two squares each if empty, once.

rows.name: Blockade
rows.effect: Wall the enemy front: their pawns cannot advance or capture for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Buff Thief (Minor)
rows.effect: Steal one tier 1 or 2 buff from your opponent. Locked-in upgrades stay put.

rows.name: Buzzer Beater
rows.effect: Steal a buzzer-beating 20 seconds off your opponent's clock and put it on yours.

rows.name: Cascade Freeze
rows.effect: For 3 turns, each capture you make freezes the nearest enemy piece 1 turn.

rows.name: Chain Nullify
rows.effect: Cancel the next buff your opponent drafts before use.

rows.name: Comet Shard
rows.effect: A shard of a passing comet crashes onto the board as a bishop: place it on any empty square in your half. It lands still glowing and cannot be captured for your opponent's next turn.

rows.name: Computer Virus
rows.effect: Upload a virus to your opponent's clock. At the end of each of their next 5 turns it drains 8 seconds from their time. The clock floor still stops it from flagging them instantly.

rows.name: Let It Ride
rows.effect: Flip a coin and let your winnings ride. Each heads bumps the prize and flips again, up to three. One heads pays 40 seconds. Two heads pays a knight in your pocket. Three heads pays a knight and a bishop plus 20 seconds. Tails on the first flip loses the ante, your weakest pawn.

rows.name: Day One Patch
rows.effect: The devs buffed pawns, but only in YOUR build: for your next 2 turns your pawns may also step one square diagonally forward onto empty squares (never onto the last rank).

rows.name: Deadline
rows.effect: Every deliverable now costs overtime: your opponent's next 3 captures each cost them 15 seconds off the clock.

rows.name: Detonate
rows.effect: Sacrifice one pawn to clear all pieces on its adjacent squares except kings.

rows.name: Direwolf Pack
rows.effect: Two spectral direwolves answer your howl: place two knights on empty squares in your half. The pack melts back into the mist after 5 of your turns.

rows.name: Double or Nothing
rows.effect: Bet one of your other held cards on a coin flip. Heads: it is upgraded two tiers. Tails: it is knocked down one tier, but you keep it.

rows.name: Duelist
rows.effect: One piece survives the first capture against it and the attacker dies instead, once (kings excluded).

rows.name: Fan Club
rows.effect: The home crowd guards your bench: while you have as many or more pieces as your opponent, your pawns on your back three ranks cannot be captured. Fall behind on material and the cheering stops.

rows.name: Fault Line
rows.effect: Split the board; enemy pieces cannot cross one file you pick, for 2 turns.

rows.name: Forearm Veins
rows.effect: Veins run dead straight up the forearm: for the game, each of your pawns may also capture the enemy piece directly ahead of it, one square straight forward.

rows.name: Gamble
rows.effect: Flip a fair coin, heads half the time. Heads: for your next two draft offers you take every card instead of one, and your next offer rolls a tier higher. Tails: both you and your opponent skip your next draft, but your following offer still rolls a tier higher.

rows.name: Giant Slayer
rows.effect: Your pawns carry slings and know the soft spots: twice this game, one of your pawns may capture an enemy piece on any square directly beside it.

rows.name: Grand Recall
rows.effect: Return your queen (if on board) to any empty square in your half, once.

rows.name: Greenhouse
rows.effect: Raise a glass dome over one file. For the game, your pawns may promote one rank early, on your 7th rank instead of your 8th, when they advance along that file, capture out of it, or capture into it.

rows.name: Hero's Journey
rows.effect: The call to adventure rings out: your next draft shows three cards to pick from, and your bank offer improves by one tier.

rows.name: Hold the Bridge
rows.effect: One hero plants their feet: choose one of your knights, bishops, or rooks. It cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns, but it stands its ground and cannot move for those turns either.

rows.name: I Love Abs
rows.effect: Brace your core. Every one of your pieces standing in the central 16 squares becomes uncapturable for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Immobilizer
rows.effect: One piece freezes all adjacent enemy pieces except kings while it stands there.

rows.name: Insurance
rows.effect: The first time your queen is captured, a new knight appears on your queen's starting square (d1 for White, d8 for Black), or on the nearest empty square of that rank if her home is taken. Triggers once.

rows.name: Iron Wall
rows.effect: Every piece on your back rank, your king aside, is uncapturable for 2 turns.

rows.name: King of the Hill
rows.effect: Your king rules the hill: while it stands on or beside one of the four center squares it may move like a queen.

rows.name: Kingslide
rows.effect: Your king moves any distance in a straight line, once.

rows.name: Lirili Larila
rows.effect: The cactus-elephant trades your afternoon for its hourglass: steal 45 seconds from your opponent's clock, but you skip your own next turn.

rows.name: Mass Freeze
rows.effect: Freeze every enemy piece except the king for 1 full turn.

rows.name: Mass Recall
rows.effect: Return any two pieces to your back rank, once.

rows.name: Metamorphosis
rows.effect: Force a violent change of form on one of your own pawns, knights, or bishops: it reshapes itself into a rook, once.

rows.name: Mirror
rows.effect: Copy one random unspent buff your opponent holds. Locked-in upgrades cannot be copied.

rows.name: Moai Head
rows.effect: A stone moai drops onto an empty square of your choice and just... stands there: for the next 4 turns of each side, NO piece from either side may move onto that square. Then it crumbles. It offers no further comment. 🗿

rows.name: Muscle Up
rows.effect: Explosive pull-up: take one of your pieces except the king and hurl it straight up its own file to any empty square, blurring past everything in the way. Once.

rows.name: Mystery Box
rows.effect: Rattle the crate and pop the lid: your next draft offer rolls at a completely random tier, anywhere from 2 to 7.

rows.name: Overrun
rows.effect: Your pawns can capture straight ahead on your next turn.

rows.name: Overtime Pay
rows.effect: You clock in and cash out on the spot: 105 seconds go straight onto your own clock the moment you play this. Time and a half, paid in full.

rows.name: Phantom Guardian
rows.effect: Call up a phantom guardian that fights beside you as a bishop for 5 of your turns, then dissolves back into the aether.

rows.name: Phantom Rook
rows.effect: Spawn a rook that vanishes after 4 turns, on any empty square in your half.

rows.name: Photosynthesis
rows.effect: Your pawns grow toward the light: after every 3 of your turns, one of your pawns advances one square on its own (the pawn nearest promotion that has an empty square ahead). It never auto-advances onto the promotion rank.

rows.name: Pinocchio
rows.effect: One pawn's nose grows: each of your turns it does not capture, its reach grows by one square, up to plus four. It may capture the first enemy piece other than a king directly ahead of it within that reach. Capturing shrinks the nose back to zero.

rows.name: Pizza Delivery
rows.effect: The delivery scooter double-parks and the boxes pile up: choose three empty squares; your opponent's pieces cannot move onto them for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Pop-up Ad
rows.effect: An ad nobody can close appears on the board: place a knight on any empty square. It is finally dismissed after 4 of your turns.

rows.name: Blue Screen of Death
rows.effect: Their whole board bluescreens and reboots: collecting error info, then a slow restart. Your opponent's clock loses 35 seconds.

rows.name: Captcha Check
rows.effect: Select all squares with a bicycle to continue. Verification fails: whichever piece type your opponent has moved the most is locked and cannot move for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: NerfChess Defender
rows.effect: Threat detected. A fake antivirus sweeps their board and quarantines up to 2 random enemy pieces: they cannot move for 2 of your opponent's turns. Kings are too big to quarantine.

rows.name: Forced Update
rows.effect: Installing update 1 of 3, do not turn off your opponent. A progress bar crawls: at the end of each of their next 3 turns their clock loses 8 seconds.

rows.name: Pop-up Storm
rows.effect: HOT DEALS raining on their side: plant 2 pop-up windows on empty squares in your opponent's half. For your next 5 turns, any enemy piece that clicks onto one (a king is too careful to) is closed out of the game.

rows.name: Ratio'd
rows.effect: Nobody asked, plus you fell off: if your opponent captured a piece on their last turn, that piece gets bonked straight back toward its own side by up to 2 squares.

rows.name: Regroup
rows.effect: Return your advanced pawns to their starting rank where empty, once.

rows.name: Reinforcements
rows.effect: Two pawns march in from the depot right now: place them on empty squares of your back two ranks.

rows.name: Resurrect
rows.effect: Bring back your strongest captured piece to your half, once.

rows.name: Resurrect Major
rows.effect: Revive a captured rook or bishop to any empty square, once.

rows.name: RGB Keyboard
rows.effect: Light up every key. For the game your knights add a 1-square step any direction, your bishops slide 2 straight, and your rooks slide 2 diagonally.

rows.name: Royal Decree
rows.effect: Your king gains queen movement for 2 turns (still loses on capture).

rows.name: Sea Monkeys
rows.effect: Just add water: four tiny pawns hatch on random empty squares in your half and grow into real pawns.

rows.name: Second Army
rows.effect: Add two pawns to your pocket, then drop them onto empty squares on later turns.

rows.name: Shieldmaiden
rows.effect: A shieldmaiden plants herself before one of your pieces: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Snooze Button
rows.effect: Pump sleeping gas down one file you pick: every enemy piece except the king standing on that file falls asleep and cannot move for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Solstice
rows.effect: The longest day gives everyone one more step: for your next turn, every one of your knights, bishops, rooks, and queens can also step one square in any direction.

rows.name: Staff of Stasis
rows.effect: Bind the staff to one of your pieces: whoever dares capture it is locked in a bubble of frozen time for 3 of their turns. The ward lasts the rest of the game.

rows.name: Sugar Rush
rows.effect: Slam a sugar rush: take three extra moves right now. Then comes the sugar crash and you skip your next turn.

rows.name: Suppress
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot draft manipulation buffs next draft.

rows.name: The Tower
rows.effect: You deal your opponent the worst card in the deck: name one enemy rook and it crumbles to rubble where it stands.

rows.name: Total Recall
rows.effect: Pull each of your pieces past your 4th rank back to your 3rd rank where empty, once.

rows.name: Tralalero Tralala
rows.effect: The shark in sneakers sprints: dash any piece except the king to an empty square along its rank, file, or diagonal, blurring straight past anything between. It moves so fast it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns. Once.

rows.name: Trapdoor
rows.effect: Rig a spring on an empty square. For your next 4 turns, an enemy piece except a king that steps onto it is flung one square back toward its home rank and cannot move for 1 of their turns. A slapstick trap, not a delete.

rows.name: Twin Knights
rows.effect: Both knights become nightrooks, for the game.

rows.name: Arcane Conduit
rows.effect: One of your rooks may also move up to two squares diagonally for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Bind the Queen
rows.effect: Arcane chains seize the enemy queen and every piece standing next to her: they cannot move for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Borrowed Minute
rows.effect: Borrow one enemy knight for a minute: it fights for you for your next 2 turns, then walks back to their side. If it dies meanwhile, the loan is settled.

rows.name: Camel Rider
rows.effect: All your knights also make a longer 3-by-1 camel leap for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Chrono Siphon
rows.effect: Steal up to 20 seconds from your opponent's clock and freeze one enemy piece for its next 2 turns.

rows.name: Conjured Bishop
rows.effect: Conjure your bishop's reflection: choose one of your bishops whose mirror square (same rank, file flipped left-to-right) is empty, and a new bishop appears there.

rows.name: Disjunction
rows.effect: The conjuration is disjoined: up to two pieces waiting in your opponent's pocket wink out of existence, strongest first.

rows.name: Disrupt Ritual
rows.effect: Your opponent's next draft is skipped, and your next draft offer shows three cards instead of two.

rows.name: Dominate
rows.effect: Take control of one enemy knight or bishop for your next 3 turns. When the time is up it reverts to your opponent.

rows.name: Far Step
rows.effect: Teleport one of your pieces (not the king) to any empty square on the board, once.

rows.name: Glyph Seal
rows.effect: Seal one file: pick any square and its whole file becomes impassable to your opponent for their next 2 turns, and every enemy piece already standing on it is bound in place for its next 2 turns.

rows.name: High Roll
rows.effect: Force your next draft offer to roll at tier 5.

rows.name: Mind Read
rows.effect: Your opponent's next drafted buff arrives nullified, and their reroll token slips away if they hold one.

rows.name: Quicken
rows.effect: Time reasserts itself around your army: every freeze, stasis, and walnut afflicting YOUR pieces is dispelled on the spot.

rows.name: Stone the Pawns
rows.effect: Turn every one of your opponent's pawns to stone for their next 3 turns: each may only shuffle one square at a time and cannot break into a full stride.

rows.name: Fold Space
rows.effect: Swap the squares of up to two pairs of your own pieces, once.

rows.name: Time Stop
rows.effect: Stop one piece in time, yours or theirs (never a king): for 2 of its owner's turns it cannot move, and it cannot be captured. It is simply not here right now.

rows.name: Void Rift
rows.effect: Tear a permanent rift on an empty square: any enemy piece that steps onto it (never a king) is pulled out of the game, and any enemy piece that ends its move on a square next to the rift is frozen for its next turn.

rows.name: Warding Circle
rows.effect: You chalk a circle of old names around your throne: no enemy piece may end its move on any of the squares around your king, for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Warp Field
rows.effect: Move any two of your pieces one square each ignoring rules, once.

rows.name: Warp Reign
rows.effect: Swap the positions of your king and queen and shield both for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Warp Rook
rows.effect: One rook teleports to any empty square on the board, once.

rows.name: Banana Peel Trail
rows.effect: Grease one file with banana peels: pieces may still enter it, but the first enemy piece to do so slips one square back toward its own home rank and is too dazed to move on its next turn.

rows.name: Body Double
rows.effect: Slip one of your opponent's knights or bishops a better offer: it switches to your side for the rest of the game, once. Kings cannot be swayed.

rows.name: Butterfingers
rows.effect: Your whole army is slathered in butter: enemy pawns and knights cannot capture your pieces for their next 2 turns. Nothing short-armed can keep a grip.

rows.name: Chaos Reigns
rows.effect: Fairness goes out the window: take two extra moves right now, but your opponent also takes two extra moves on their next turn.

rows.name: Lost and Found
rows.effect: Dig through the lost and found: return one of your captured pieces other than the queen to an empty square in your half, once. The heaviest lost piece comes back first.

rows.name: Panic Button
rows.effect: Slam the big red button: your king cannot be captured on your opponent's next turn, and you take one extra move right now to sort out the mess.

rows.name: Pinata
rows.effect: Swing wildly and hope: one random enemy piece other than the king is knocked off the board, but one of your own pawns bursts in the mess and is lost too.

rows.name: Quicksand Patch
rows.effect: Every one of your opponent's pawns sinks into quicksand and can only crawl one square at a time for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Tar Pit
rows.effect: Every one of your opponent's bishops is stuck fast and cannot move for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Yeet
rows.effect: Wind up and launch one of your own pieces deep into enemy territory: send it to any empty square in your opponent's half, once. Your king stays put.

rows.name: Ancient Grove
rows.effect: Old roots give one piece back: return a captured rook, knight, or bishop to an empty square on your back rank, once.

rows.name: Backdraft
rows.effect: The next 3 times your opponent captures one of your pieces, every enemy piece other than a pawn or king on the squares around it is destroyed.

rows.name: Glaciate
rows.effect: Freeze one enemy piece (never a king) for 3 of their turns, and the frost spreads: every enemy piece directly beside it (up, down, left, or right) is frozen for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Hailstorm
rows.effect: Freeze every one of your opponent's pawns for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Lightning Bolt
rows.effect: One queen looses a bolt down a diagonal, removing the first enemy piece it hits (never a king) and landing beyond it, once.

rows.name: Stone Soldiers
rows.effect: One of your pawns is carved into a stone soldier: it cannot move and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 6 turns, then the stone crumbles and it wakes.

rows.name: Thunderhead
rows.effect: A charged cloud takes shape as a knight on an empty square in your half, and its arrival blasts one enemy pawn standing beside it off the board. It fights for 3 of your turns, then rolls away.

rows.name: Undertow
rows.effect: A current sweeps one of your pieces to any empty square, then drags the nearest enemy piece one square toward where it lands.

rows.name: Verdant Shield
rows.effect: A canopy of bark: all of your pawns cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns. Any enemy pawn directly in front of one of your pawns is rooted and cannot move for 1 turn.

rows.name: White Monster
rows.effect: Crack the can: take 2 extra moves right now for a triple-move turn. Then the sugar crash hits and you skip your next turn. Once.

rows.name: Bayonet Charge
rows.effect: One of your bishops charges diagonally, capturing the first enemy piece in its path and landing just beyond, once.

rows.name: Bombardment
rows.effect: Remove two enemy pawns you name from the board, once.

rows.name: Command Tent
rows.effect: Your king may also move like a knight, for the game.

rows.name: Counter Charge
rows.effect: The first time your opponent captures one of your pieces, the capturing piece is frozen in place for its next 2 turns.

rows.name: Defectors
rows.effect: Turn one enemy pawn or knight to your side for the rest of the game, once. Kings cannot be swayed.

rows.name: Field Fortification
rows.effect: Your pawns may also capture the enemy piece directly ahead of them, for the game.

rows.name: Flanking Knights
rows.effect: Both of your knights may also step one square in any direction like a king, for the game.

rows.name: Forward Observer
rows.effect: The observer calls in indirect fire: for your next 2 turns, your rooks may capture an enemy piece along a rank or file even when exactly one piece stands in the way. The blocker is unharmed; the rook lands on its target.

rows.name: Last Reserves
rows.effect: Commit everything: up to two of your captured knights or bishops return to empty squares on your back rank, once.

rows.name: Outriders
rows.effect: Place a new knight on any empty square in your half, then advance one of your pawns one square.

rows.name: Recommission
rows.effect: Return one of your captured rooks to an empty square on your back rank. For the rest of the game the refitted rook may pass through one friendly piece on each move.

rows.name: Reserve Cavalry
rows.effect: The reserve waits for the line to break: the first time your opponent captures one of your pieces, a knight rides in on the empty back-rank square nearest your king's file.

rows.name: Shieldbearers
rows.effect: While at least one of your pawns stands on a square beside your king, your king cannot be captured, for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Suppressive Fire
rows.effect: Every one of your opponent's knights is pinned down for their next 2 turns, and so is every enemy pawn standing directly beside one.

rows.name: Wyvern's Dive
rows.effect: A wyvern folds its wings and dives: one of your knights streaks in a straight line, snatches up to the first two enemy pieces it reaches, and lands just beyond, once.

rows.name: Zodiac Wheel
rows.effect: You read all twelve houses at once: your next draft shows three cards to pick from, all fated to tier 4.

rows.name: Abyss
rows.effect: Two squares you pick swallow any enemy piece except a king that enters, for the game.

rows.name: Alt+F4
rows.effect: Their whole client crashes to desktop and takes a minute to reboot: your opponent's clock loses 60 seconds.

rows.name: Annihilate
rows.effect: Remove one enemy piece below the queen, and freeze every enemy piece orthogonally beside it for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Apotheosis
rows.effect: Raise one of your knights, bishops, or rooks to godhood: it leaves the board for a higher plane, and a queen joins your pocket to descend in its place on a later turn.

rows.name: Atomic Captures
rows.effect: Whenever one of your pieces captures, every enemy piece on the 8 squares around the captured square is also removed, except kings and pawns. Lasts the whole game.

rows.name: Bee Swarm Simulator
rows.effect: Release the hive: drop 3 bee pawns on empty squares of the two center ranks, a buzzing swarm that harasses both armies from no-mans-land.

rows.name: Bombombini Gusini
rows.effect: The bomber-goose lobs a stun grenade on a square: every enemy piece except a king in the 5 by 5 area centred on it (that square and the 24 around it) is bonked and cannot move for their next 2 turns. Nobody is removed.

rows.name: Borrowed Time
rows.effect: Your queen becomes uncapturable for your next 4 moves, and then her time runs out: she is removed from the board.

rows.name: Buff Thief
rows.effect: Steal one active buff of any tier from your opponent. Locked-in upgrades stay put.

rows.name: Cavalry Charge
rows.effect: Charge a knight straight along a rank or file: it smashes the first two enemy pieces it hits (never kings), then rolls on to the far side of them, stopping before the next piece or the edge. Its landing shock shoves every enemy a knight's leap away one square back toward home. A friendly piece or enemy king stops the charge. Once.

rows.name: Chain Lightning
rows.effect: One bishop captures up to three enemy pieces down a diagonal and lands beyond them; the bolt then jumps on to freeze the next enemy piece further along that diagonal for 2 of their turns, once.

rows.name: Checkmate Immunity
rows.effect: The first time your king is checked, it cannot be captured on the following turn, once.

rows.name: Collapse
rows.effect: Pull every enemy piece except the king one square toward their back rank across the whole board, once.

rows.name: Roulette Wheel
rows.effect: You put it all on red and the croupier spins. Land red for a knight in your pocket and 30 seconds. Land black and you lose your weakest piece. Land the green zero and the house cleans you out: lose your weakest piece and your next draft is skipped.

rows.name: Slot Machine
rows.effect: Pull the arm and watch three reels spin. Match all three symbols for the jackpot: a rook and a knight drop into your pocket to place later, plus 45 seconds. Match two for a knight in your pocket. Match none and the machine eats your weakest piece.

rows.name: Danielle
rows.effect: Sunshine: grow three new pawns on any empty squares in your own half, basking in a warmth that keeps each of them uncapturable for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Divine Intervention
rows.effect: Your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns, and the first enemy piece to strike at your king in that time is hurled clean off the board. Kings are never banished.

rows.name: Double Queen
rows.effect: Promote any pawn to a queen instantly, even mid-board.

rows.name: Draft Domination
rows.effect: Force your opponent's next draft down to tier 2, so both cards they are offered come from a weak tier.

rows.name: Dragon Form
rows.effect: One of your rooks unfurls a pair of dragon wings: for the game it also moves diagonally, ranging the board like a queen.

rows.name: Dragon's Breath
rows.effect: One rook captures every enemy piece in a straight line in a single move, once.

rows.name: Dryad Grove
rows.effect: The grove parts for the clergy: your bishops may slide through your own pawns (never capturing them), for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Excalibur
rows.effect: One of your bishops also moves like a rook for the game, giving it full queen movement.

rows.name: Expansion Permit
rows.effect: The construction crew bolts a ninth file onto the board: for your next 4 turns your rooks and queens may slide off one side of the board and back on the other.

rows.name: Extra Move (Repeat)
rows.effect: Take two moves in a row every turn for 2 full turns. You cannot capture the king on the bonus moves: your opponent replies first.

rows.name: Favorable Stars
rows.effect: You cast your chart and the houses agree: your next draft is fated to offer tier 5 cards.

rows.name: Fey Step
rows.effect: One of your knights or bishops slips into the hedgerow and steps out behind their lines: move it to any empty square on your opponent's back two ranks, once.

rows.name: Frigo Camelo
rows.effect: The fridge-camel opens both doors: two of your pieces (never the king) are refrigerated: they cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns, but each is frozen solid for 1 of your turns while it defrosts.

rows.name: Fur Elise
rows.effect: Run your fingers down the keys. Choose a bishop and glide it along one diagonal, sweeping away up to 3 enemy pieces in its path as it lands.

rows.name: Ghost Legion
rows.effect: All your pawns may jump over a blocker one square ahead, landing two ahead where empty, for 2 turns.

rows.name: God Knight
rows.effect: One knight becomes an amazon (queen plus knight), for the game.

rows.name: Great Wall
rows.effect: One full rank you pick is impassable to enemies for 3 turns.

rows.name: Griffon Rider
rows.effect: Move up to two of your pieces to any empty squares, once.

rows.name: Haerin
rows.effect: Cat's pounce: choose one of your pieces, then an enemy a knight's leap away. Snatch that piece off the board, land yours on its square, and it stands shielded, uncapturable for your opponent's next turn.

rows.name: Hanni
rows.effect: Spotlight: choose an enemy piece. It and every enemy piece within two squares of it are charmed and cannot move for their next 2 turns. Kings shrug it off.

rows.name: Home Field
rows.effect: Home advantage: while standing in your own half of the board or one rank past it, each of your knights, bishops, and rooks may also step one square in any direction.

rows.name: Hunter Knight
rows.effect: One knight captures a piece one leap away and lands a second leap beyond, once.

rows.name: Hyein
rows.effect: Long legs: for the game each of your pawns may also stride straight forward to the first, second, or third empty square ahead, springing over anything in between.

rows.name: Ironclad
rows.effect: Every piece on your back two ranks, your king aside, cannot be captured for 2 turns.

rows.name: Joseph Leung
rows.effect: Sign the board. Bind one of your pieces: for the game it moves as a knight and queen at once, and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 4 turns.

rows.name: Last Meal
rows.effect: Your king ties on a napkin. For your next 3 turns it may capture any enemy piece (other than a king) up to two squares away, leaping over anything in between.

rows.name: Main Character
rows.effect: One of your pieces gets plot armor: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 4 turns.

rows.name: Mass Promote Minor
rows.effect: Two pawns on your 4th rank or beyond become knights instantly.

rows.name: Middle Part
rows.effect: Not one hair off the axis: choose one of your pieces except the king or queen, and a perfect mirror copy of it materializes on the file-reflected square (a-file to h-file), if that square is empty. Once.

rows.name: Mind Control
rows.effect: Take control of one enemy knight or bishop (turn it to your color) for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Minji
rows.effect: Leader's guard: every one of your pieces standing within two squares of your king links arms and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 5 turns.

rows.name: Mortgage
rows.effect: Take out a loan against your home: summon a rook on any empty square. The bank keeps the deed, so you can never castle again for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Nova
