rows.effect: Sacrifice one pawn to clear every enemy piece except the king from its file, once.

rows.name: One Arm Muscle Up Is My Dream
rows.effect: One chosen piece reaches for the bar: forever it also slides diagonally like a bishop, extending one long arm across the board on top of its own moves.

rows.name: Overclock Major
rows.effect: All your pieces may move like kings as an alternative, for 1 turn.

rows.name: Phase Army
rows.effect: Your bishops, rooks, and queen pass through one friendly piece per move for 2 turns.

rows.name: Chain Letter
rows.effect: Forward to 10 friends or else: a cursed email hops around their army. One random enemy piece freezes each of your opponent's next 3 turns, jumping to a different piece every time. Never a king.

rows.name: Promotion Storm
rows.effect: All pawns on your 5th rank or beyond promote to knights.

rows.name: Purge
rows.effect: Remove one enemy piece below queen rank from the board.

rows.name: Purge Storm
rows.effect: Remove three enemy pawns and freeze the rest for 1 turn.

rows.name: Rampart
rows.effect: Place a pawn on each of three empty squares you choose in your half; those three pawns cannot be captured for your opponent's next 5 turns.

rows.name: Rent-a-Rook
rows.effect: A rook arrives on loan: place it on an empty square in your half. It cannot be captured while it is on loan (it is not yours to lose), then it drives off after 5 of your turns.

rows.name: Riddle Game
rows.effect: You wager the deck itself on a dangerous game: your opponent's next two drafts are skipped, but so is your own next one.

rows.name: Rift Walker
rows.effect: One piece teleports anywhere on the board, once.

rows.name: Roulette
rows.effect: Spin the wheel three times: three random enemy pieces other than the king are removed from the board.

rows.name: The Round Table
rows.effect: Two sworn knights answer your call and wait in your pocket: spend a later turn to drop each onto any empty square.

rows.name: Rubik's Cube
rows.effect: Scramble the cube: make up to 3 twists, each swapping the spots of two of your own pieces standing within 2 squares of each other. Kings never twist.

rows.name: Sever
rows.effect: Permanently disable one enemy buff and block its retrigger.

rows.name: Shatter
rows.effect: Shatter one enemy rook, bishop, or knight into a walnut for the rest of the game: it can only shuffle one square at a time.

rows.name: Siege Rook
rows.effect: One rook captures every enemy piece in a straight line in one move, then the swept rank or file stays barred to your opponent for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Skibidi Flush
rows.effect: The porcelain vortex opens: up to 3 chosen enemy pieces (never the king) are flushed back to their home squares (or, if home is taken, to the nearest empty square toward home). Nothing is captured; everything is humiliated.

rows.name: Spirit Guide
rows.effect: A patient spirit settles into one of your pieces: for your next 4 turns it may also step one square in any direction, and it cannot be captured while the spirit stays.

rows.name: Starfall
rows.effect: A rook crashes down into your pocket, and a chip of star-iron lands with it as a pawn: drop them onto empty squares on later turns.

rows.name: Starlight Ward
rows.effect: Starlight pools around the crown: your pieces standing on the squares beside your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Stone Golem
rows.effect: Bind a spirit into rock and stone: a lumbering golem serves as a rook for 6 of your turns, then crumbles back to rubble.

rows.name: Swap Meet
rows.effect: Set up a stall and shake on a deal: your lowest-tier held card and a random one of your opponent's held cards are swapped between you.

rows.name: Threads of Fate
rows.effect: The loom repays every cut thread: for your opponent's next 3 captures, you weave an extra move into your reply.

rows.name: Time Out
rows.effect: The referee throws a flag on your opponent: their next draft is skipped and their clock loses 15 seconds.

rows.name: Time Thief
rows.effect: Pick your opponent's pocket: steal half of the time left on their clock (up to 75 seconds) and add it to your own.

rows.name: Tung Tung Tung Sahur
rows.effect: The drum-man marches on your opponent's king. On each of your next 5 turns, the two enemy pieces nearest their king are bonked and cannot move for their next 2 turns. Kings are too stubborn to bonk.

rows.name: Twin Queens
rows.effect: Promote two pawns to queens instantly if both are on your 5th rank or beyond.

rows.name: Understudy
rows.effect: The first time your queen is captured, one of your bishops, or a knight if you have no bishop, immediately turns into a queen on its own square. If you have neither, nothing happens. Triggers once.

rows.name: Union Rules
rows.effect: Your pieces get mandated rest: for your opponent's next 2 turns after they capture one of your pieces, they cannot make a capture. If capturing is their only legal option, the rule is waived for that turn.

rows.name: Uniqlo Warrior
rows.effect: Suit up in the daily fit. Your entire army cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Arrest the Hour
rows.effect: Freeze one enemy rook or queen for 3 of their turns.

rows.name: Border Ward
rows.effect: A warded frontier: your opponent may not move any piece into your half of the board for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Conjured Rook
rows.effect: Conjure a spectral rook into your pocket, then spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square. It stays as long as you do.

rows.name: Frozen Moment
rows.effect: Seal this moment in glass: choose one enemy piece except a king. After 3 of their turns, wherever it has run to, it is snapped back to the square it stands on right now (if that square is free again).

rows.name: Royal Aegis
rows.effect: Your king and your queen cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Sabotage
rows.effect: Saboteurs in their war room: your opponent's next draft is skipped, and their reroll token is stolen away if they still hold one.

rows.name: Spelltheft
rows.effect: A trade, technically: steal any one of your opponent's unused buffs, but the spell demands payment: your own lowest-tier unused card goes to them in exchange.

rows.name: Stolen Hours
rows.effect: Steal 20 seconds from your opponent's clock and take one extra move this turn. You cannot capture the king on the bonus move.

rows.name: Twin Blink
rows.effect: Two knots in the world come undone at once: choose one of your pieces and one enemy piece (kings aside); each blinks away to a random empty square.

rows.name: Twin Familiars
rows.effect: A familiar perches on each of your bishops: for the rest of the game your bishops may also step one square straight (up, down, or sideways), finally changing their color.

rows.name: Unmake
rows.effect: The next capture your opponent makes is unmade: their piece snaps back to the square it came from, and your captured piece is restored where it stood. Kings cannot be unmade.

rows.name: Warp Legion
rows.effect: The legion rallies to the crown: up to three of your pieces teleport to empty squares beside your king, once.

rows.name: Attack Goose
rows.effect: An attack goose invades your opponent's half as a knight for 3 of your turns, then honks off.

rows.name: Berserk Pawn
rows.effect: One of your pawns flies into a frenzy: for your next 3 turns it also moves like a queen, then it burns out and is removed from the board.

rows.name: Clown Car
rows.effect: Two knights pile out of one tiny car: place them on two empty squares that touch each other. Both are too dizzy to move on your next turn.

rows.name: Concrete Shoes
rows.effect: Fit one of your opponent's rooks or queens with concrete shoes: it cannot move at all for their next 3 turns, then it hardens into a walnut that can only shuffle one square at a time for the rest of the game. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Confetti Cannon
rows.effect: Your next capture goes off like a confetti cannon: every enemy piece other than a king within two squares of the captured square is blown off the board.

rows.name: Conga Line
rows.effect: The whole line dances one step to the side: every one of your pawns shifts one square toward the board edge you pick (pawns with no room sit the song out).

rows.name: Deal with the Devil
rows.effect: Sign here: promote one of your pawns to a queen at once, but the devil collects and you skip your next 2 turns.

rows.name: Haunted House
rows.effect: Two rooms turn haunted: mark two empty squares and any enemy piece that enters one, never a king, vanishes. The haunting lasts 4 of your turns.

rows.name: Hot Seat
rows.effect: The spotlight swings to their king and queen: on your opponent's next turn they may move only their king or their queen.

rows.name: Musical Chairs
rows.effect: The music stops: swap the squares of one of your pieces and one of your opponent's pieces, once. Neither may be a king.

rows.name: Repo Rook
rows.effect: A repo man's rook rolls up behind enemy lines: place it on an empty square in your opponent's half, and it tows itself away after 3 of your turns.

rows.name: Rubber Duck Squad
rows.effect: Your bishops are secretly rubber: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any enemy piece that captures one of your bishops bounces straight back to the square it came from.

rows.name: Voodoo Doll
rows.effect: Stitch a little doll of the enemy army: the first time your opponent captures one of your pieces, a random enemy piece of the very same type is destroyed in sympathy. Kings are never harmed.

rows.name: Arc Lightning
rows.effect: One rook arcs lightning along a diagonal, removing up to two enemy pieces in its path (never a king) and landing beyond them. The bolt then jumps to freeze the nearest surviving enemy piece for its next 2 turns.

rows.name: Conflagration
rows.effect: Remove two enemy pieces, each a pawn, knight, or bishop, once.

rows.name: Firestorm
rows.effect: A firestorm falls on the crossroads: every enemy piece except a king standing on the four center squares (d4, e4, d5, e5) is consumed.

rows.name: Flame Lance
rows.effect: One of your rooks breathes a lance of flame straight up its own file, without moving: the first enemy piece in the jet, if it is not a king, burns away. Friendly pieces block the flame, once.

rows.name: Frost Ward
rows.effect: Your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns. Every enemy piece that ends a move next to your king in that time is frozen for 1 turn and bonked where it stands.

rows.name: Frostbite
rows.effect: Your opponent's pieces go numb: for their next 2 turns they cannot make any capture, and no piece may move more than 2 squares.

rows.name: Overgrowth
rows.effect: One of your pawns blooms into a queen for your next 3 turns, then withers back into a pawn.

rows.name: Petrify the Ranks
rows.effect: Every enemy knight and bishop turns to stone: they cannot move for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Quagmire
rows.effect: Open two patches of sucking mud on empty squares: any enemy piece except a king that steps onto one is stuck fast for its next 3 turns instead of removed. The mud stays for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Rooted
rows.effect: Roots seize the heavy pieces: your opponent's rooks and queen cannot move for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Scorch
rows.effect: Remove one enemy knight or bishop from the board; the fire spreads to every enemy pawn standing beside it, once.

rows.name: Claymore Line
rows.effect: Mark two empty squares: the first enemy piece to step onto either one, a king aside, is destroyed along with every enemy piece on the squares around it. The mines stay armed for the game.

rows.name: Counter Battery Fire
rows.effect: Remove one enemy rook or bishop you name from the board, once.

rows.name: Demolition Charge
rows.effect: Rig one of your pieces with charges: for the game, whenever it captures an enemy piece the squares around the capture are cleared of enemy pieces. Kings are never caught in the blast.

rows.name: Form Square
rows.effect: Pick any square: your pieces standing on it or any of the up-to-eight squares around it, your king aside, cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Mass Defection
rows.effect: Turn two enemy pawns to your side for the rest of the game, once.

rows.name: Muster the Ranks
rows.effect: The trumpet sounds and the whole line steps off: every one of your pawns with an empty square ahead advances one square. Pawns one step from the last rank hold their ground.

rows.name: Paratroopers
rows.effect: Drop two new pawns onto empty squares in your opponent's half, once. They dig in where they land: neither can be captured for 1 full turn.

rows.name: Pincer Movement
rows.effect: Close both jaws at once: every enemy piece except a king caught directly between two of your pieces (left and right, above and below, or across a diagonal) is pinned and frozen for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Praetorian Guard
rows.effect: Choose one of your pieces: for your next 4 turns it cannot be captured and may also step one square in any direction like a king.

rows.name: Relentless Assault
rows.effect: Each of your next two capturing moves immediately grants you an extra move. You cannot capture the king on a bonus move: your opponent replies first.

rows.name: Spearhead
rows.effect: One of your rooks drives in a straight line, capturing up to two enemy pieces in its path and stopping. The squares it punches through stay barred to your opponent for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: All In
rows.effect: Push everything to the center. Your next draft offer is skipped. The offer after that shows three cards, and you take all three.

rows.name: Army of the Dead
rows.effect: The fallen answer the roll: one pawn musters into your pocket for every two of your pieces captured so far, plus one more, up to five in all. Drop them onto empty squares on later turns.

rows.name: Ascendant Knight
rows.effect: One knight moves as an amazon and cannot be captured, for 2 turns.

rows.name: Atomic Reaction
rows.effect: Whenever one of your pieces captures, every enemy piece except a king on the 8 squares around the captured square is removed, and each removed piece sets off the same blast around itself. Lasts the whole game.

rows.name: Bayview Secondary School
rows.effect: Detention for the whole class. Choose a square: every enemy piece except the king in the 3 by 3 around it is locked in place for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: 225 Bench
rows.effect: Press 225 and shove up to 4 enemy pieces one square back toward their own home rank. Blocked pieces stay put, nobody is captured.

rows.name: Berserker
rows.effect: For your next 3 turns, all your pieces except your king also move like a queen. For the 2 turns after that, all your pieces can move only one square.

rows.name: Brr Brr Patapim
rows.effect: The cold finds whoever wanders alone: every enemy piece except the king with no friendly piece on any square beside it freezes solid for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Buff Siphon
rows.effect: Steal two active buffs from your opponent. Locked-in upgrades stay put.

rows.name: Cappuccino Assassino
rows.effect: The espresso assassin strikes before the foam settles: the enemy piece nearest your king (never their king) is destroyed, and the two enemy pieces nearest the scene of the crime are stunned for their next turn.

rows.name: Cataclysm
rows.effect: Clear all enemy pawns on the board.

rows.name: Celestial Ascension
rows.effect: Your bishops ascend to a higher plane: for the game every one of them also moves in straight lines like a rook, wielding a queen's full reach.

rows.name: Clone Army
rows.effect: Four photocopier flashes in a row: four new pawns land in your pocket, ready to drop onto empty squares on later turns.

rows.name: Colossus
rows.effect: One piece becomes uncapturable and gains queen movement for 3 turns.

rows.name: Blackjack
rows.effect: The dealer feeds you cards until your hand reaches seventeen, then you stand. Hit twenty one for a rook in your pocket and 45 seconds. Stand on seventeen to twenty for a minor piece in your pocket. Bust over twenty one and the house takes your weakest piece while you cool off for two turns.

rows.name: Poker Bluff
rows.effect: You shove all in holding nothing and stare them down. Roughly forty five times in a hundred they fold and you rake one of their pieces into the pot along with 20 seconds. The rest of the time they call your bluff, and you pay your weakest piece and take a two turn walk of shame.

rows.name: The Death Arcana
rows.effect: The thirteenth card turns face up and names its mark: choose one enemy piece except a king. It is doomed: after 4 of their turns it dies, wherever it has run to. Only being captured first spares it the mark.

rows.name: Detonation Field
rows.effect: Your next three captures each explode adjacent enemy pieces.

rows.name: Divine Mandate
rows.effect: You speak with the authority of heaven: one enemy knight, bishop, or rook joins your army, and heaven shields the defection so it cannot be recaptured for your opponent's next 3 turns. Kings cannot be swayed.

rows.name: Double Amazon
rows.effect: All your knights move as amazons for your next 3 turns.

rows.name: Draft Seize
rows.effect: Take both cards in your next draft and skip your opponent's next, though they gain a reroll in return.

rows.name: Dragon Mount
rows.effect: One of your knights breaks a young dragon to the saddle: for the game it may also slide any distance diagonally.

rows.name: Fissure
rows.effect: One file becomes impassable to enemies for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Full Planche
rows.effect: Lock one of your pieces into a perfect hold. It hovers uncapturable for your opponent's next 5 turns and slides like a rook along every open rank and file for the game.

rows.name: Geometry Dash
rows.effect: One of your pieces hits the beat: it dashes straight forward, phasing over your own pieces and smashing up to 2 enemies in its lane before landing. Never kings.

rows.name: Giant's Maul
rows.effect: The maul comes down once: crush one enemy knight, bishop, or rook, and the shock leaves every enemy piece beside it (kings aside) frozen for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Glass Cannon
rows.effect: Choose a bishop. For your next 4 turns it can capture any enemy except the king along its diagonals, passing through anything in between. But while it is overcharged, if it is captured, two of your pawns shatter with it.

rows.name: God-King
rows.effect: Your king walks between heartbeats: it may also leap like a knight, for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Golden Touch
rows.effect: The next two enemy pieces you capture (other than kings) are reforged as your own and added to your army on empty squares in your half. The price of greed: each reforging turns one of your pawns to gold, and it is lost.

rows.name: Gossamer Veil
rows.effect: A shimmering veil of spider-silk tangles every long blade: your pieces cannot be captured by enemy bishops, rooks, or queens for your opponent's next 3 turns. Pawns, knights, and kings still cut through.

rows.name: Grand Summon
rows.effect: Add a knight and a bishop to your pocket, then drop them onto empty squares on later turns.

rows.name: Gravity Well
rows.effect: Your king bends space around it: enemy pieces standing within two squares of your king are caught in orbit and cannot move to a square farther from it. Enemy kings are not affected.

rows.name: Guardian Angel
rows.effect: Twice per game, when your opponent captures one of your pieces (not your king), that piece is spirited to safety instead: an identical piece reappears on an empty square deep in your own half.

rows.name: Horn of Summoning
rows.effect: One long note wakes the stone itself: for the rest of the game, your rooks may also step one square diagonally.

rows.name: I Love Cami
rows.effect: Place Cami on an empty square in your half: a queen who also leaps like a knight. Devotion: allies standing beside her cannot be captured. If she is ever taken, her captor is frozen for 2 turns.

rows.name: I Love NewJeans
rows.effect: Harmony: for the game, every non-king piece of yours that stands next to a friendly piece may also step one square in any direction.

rows.name: I Love Chaewon
rows.effect: Fearless choreography: gracefully reposition up to 3 of your pieces, gliding each to any empty square in your own half of the board.

rows.name: I Love Making Out
rows.effect: Bond two of your pieces for the game. Each also moves the way the other does, blending a knight with a bishop or a rook with a queen.

rows.name: Judgment Day
rows.effect: A pillar of holy light smites one enemy knight, bishop, rook, or queen you name, then petrifies the two enemy pieces nearest the impact into stone for the rest of the game. Kings are never petrified.

rows.name: Landlord
rows.effect: Claim four empty squares as your property. Any enemy piece (never a king) that ends its move on one of them owes rent: it is stuck fast for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Lich Phylactery
rows.effect: The first time your queen is captured, a new queen appears on her home square, or on the nearest empty square of your back rank if her home is taken.

rows.name: Lightning Strike
rows.effect: Call lightning down on up to three enemy knights, bishops, or pawns, removing them from the board.

rows.name: Magnetism
rows.effect: Your knights are magnetized: after each knight move, the nearest enemy piece (never a king) is dragged up to two squares toward that knight, as long as the squares between them are empty.

rows.name: Mind Dominion
rows.effect: Take control of one enemy rook or bishop for the game.

rows.name: Minefield
rows.effect: Seed three mines on empty squares. The first enemy piece, never a king, to step on each mine is destroyed, and the blast removes every enemy piece except kings on the 8 squares around it. Shielded pieces resist the blast.

rows.name: Mirror of Souls
rows.effect: You hold the glass between two reflections: one of your pieces trades places with an enemy piece of the same kind. Kings cast no reflection.

rows.name: Overwhelm
rows.effect: Take three moves in a row, once. You cannot capture the king during these bonus moves: your opponent replies first.

rows.name: Pay to Win
rows.effect: Money buys more of whatever is working: choose one of your knights, bishops, or rooks, and a store-bought copy of it joins your pocket, ready to drop onto an empty square on a later turn.

rows.name: Purge Line
rows.effect: Remove every enemy piece below queen rank on one rank you pick.

rows.name: Queen's Wrath
rows.effect: In one move, your queen sweeps along one straight line, removing up to two enemy pieces on it, then freezes every enemy piece beside her landing square for their next turn; a friendly piece or an enemy king ends the line, once.

rows.name: Resurrect Queen
rows.effect: Bring your captured queen back to any empty square on the board, and she cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Royal Ascension
rows.effect: Your king gains queen movement permanently (still loses on capture).

rows.name: Second King
rows.effect: Turn one of your pawns, on any rank, into a second king. Your opponent must capture both of your kings to win.

rows.name: Sinkhole
rows.effect: The earth chooses where to open: three sinkholes appear on random empty squares in your opponent's half. Any enemy piece except a king that steps onto one plunges out of the game. They stay open the rest of the match.

rows.name: Smurf Account
rows.effect: A suspiciously strong new player joins your side mid-game: place a fresh rook on an empty square in your half.

rows.name: Time Rewind
rows.effect: Turn back time: restore some of your clock and free all of your own frozen or petrified pieces, once.

rows.name: Time Stop (Short)
rows.effect: Time stops: freeze every enemy piece except the king for 1 turn, then take one extra move right now, once. You cannot capture the king during the bonus move: your opponent replies first.

rows.name: Total Nullify
rows.effect: Cancel your opponent's unused and temporary buffs. Locked-in piece upgrades resist.

rows.name: Unseelie Bargain
rows.effect: Free action: strike a bargain with the dark court and take two extra moves right now. The price comes due and you skip your next turn.

rows.name: Valkyrie
rows.effect: A chooser of the slain rides beside your army: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any knight, bishop, or rook of yours they capture is carried home to your pocket instead of being lost for good. Drop it back onto an empty square on a later turn.

rows.name: Void
rows.effect: The void takes one enemy pawn, knight, or bishop, and the square it stood on stays a void that swallows any enemy piece except a king that enters it, for the game.

rows.name: Greed
rows.effect: Your next draft offer, you take both cards instead of choosing one.

rows.name: Leaden Crown
rows.effect: Turn one of your pawns into a queen, and the leaden crown guards it: that new queen cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Warp Storm
rows.effect: Move up to four of your pieces, your king aside, one square each in any direction onto an empty square, once.

rows.name: Double Trouble
rows.effect: One of your knights or bishops splits in two: place its exact twin on an empty square right beside it.

rows.name: Juggling Act
rows.effect: Keep every plate spinning: take three extra moves right now, then it all comes crashing down and you skip your next 2 turns.

rows.name: Wrecking Ball
rows.effect: Your queen takes one full swing in place: every enemy piece except a king on the 8 squares around her is smashed off the board. Shielded pieces resist the swing, once.

rows.name: Flash Freeze
rows.effect: Freeze every enemy piece standing next to your king for their next 2 turns and bonk it where it stands.

rows.name: Flood
rows.effect: Three floodwaters spread over empty squares: the first enemy piece to step onto each (never a king) is swept off the board. They stay for 2 of your turns.

rows.name: Glacier Wall
rows.effect: Two walls of ice rise: pick any two squares and each of their files becomes impassable to your opponent for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Immolation
rows.effect: Offer one of your own pawns to the flame: it is consumed, and the blast removes every enemy piece except kings on the 8 squares around it. Shielded pieces resist the fire.

rows.name: Mountain Range
rows.effect: Three peaks heave up out of the board: pick three empty squares; your opponent's pieces can never move onto them, for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Thorn Barrier
rows.effect: A hedge of thorns bursts up on an empty square: your opponent cannot enter any of the 8 squares around it for their next 3 turns, and any enemy piece already caught in that ring is snared and cannot move for its next 2 turns.

rows.name: Werewolf
rows.effect: Curse one of your pawns with lycanthropy: every 5 of your turns it transforms into a knight, and 5 turns later back into a pawn, for the game. If it promotes or is captured the curse lifts.

rows.name: Wheel of Fortune
rows.effect: Spin the wheel for one of six random effects: plus 55 seconds to your clock, minus 55 seconds off your opponent's, your army uncapturable for their next 2 turns, a new knight in your half, every enemy piece asleep for their next 2 turns, or two random enemy pieces other than the king removed.

rows.name: The Wild Hunt
rows.effect: The horns of the twilight court sound: pick any square, and the Hunt rides both diagonals through it, carrying off every enemy piece on them. Kings are never taken.

rows.name: Armored Breakthrough
rows.effect: One of your bishops spearheads the drive: it sweeps along one diagonal, capturing every enemy piece on it, and stops where the drive ends. Friendly pieces and enemy kings block the drive, once.

rows.name: Bridgehead
rows.effect: Place a new knight and a new pawn on empty squares in your opponent's half, once.

rows.name: Combined Arms
rows.effect: Armor learns from cavalry: for your next 3 turns, your rooks may also leap like knights.

rows.name: Double Trench
rows.effect: Pick two files: your opponent cannot move onto either file for their next 2 turns, and any enemy piece standing on those files cannot capture in that time.

rows.name: Forward Outpost
rows.effect: Place a new rook on any empty square in your opponent's half, once.

rows.name: Iron Bulwark
rows.effect: Choose one of your pieces, your king aside: while it stands in your half it cannot be captured, and enemy pieces standing next to it cannot capture at all.

rows.name: Mercenary Queen
rows.effect: Hire a sellsword who fights as a queen for 3 of your turns, then rides off with her pay.

rows.name: Aegis of the Ages
rows.effect: Lift the ancient aegis and its ward falls over your whole host, your king included: nothing you own can be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: Amazon
rows.effect: Your queen is crowned an Amazon: for the game she also moves like a knight.

rows.name: Annihilation
rows.effect: Remove any two enemy pieces below the queen from the board.

rows.name: Blood Pact
rows.effect: Sign in blood: promote one of your pawns to a queen at once, but another pawn of yours, you choose which, bursts and is lost.

rows.name: Chain Atomic
rows.effect: Every capture by or against your pieces sets off an atomic blast that clears enemy pieces around it and chains, for the game. When an enemy captures one of your pieces, the capturing piece is destroyed too.

rows.name: Chaos Theory
rows.effect: A tornado sweeps the board: every pawn, yours and your opponent's, is randomly reshuffled among the squares pawns currently stand on. Happens once.

rows.name: Chimpanzini Bananini
rows.effect: The banana-monkey goes ape: for the game every one of your knights may also slide like a queen, keeping its knight leap on top.

rows.name: Loot Box
rows.effect: Pay to crack the crate and pray to the drop table. Legendary (rare) grants a random apex card. Epic grants a bishop and 30 seconds. Rare grants a knight. Common grants a pawn. But almost one crate in three is a mimic that bites off your weakest piece and leaves you shaken for two turns.

rows.name: Deep Freeze
rows.effect: A cold snap rolls over their homeland: every enemy piece except the king still in its own half is frozen for 2 of their turns. Pieces that already crossed the border escape it.

rows.name: Divine Legion
rows.effect: Add a queen to your pocket, then spend a later turn to drop it onto any empty square.

rows.name: Draft Tyranny
rows.effect: Set both of your own next cards to tier 7, once.

rows.name: Dragonslayer
rows.effect: The old blade remembers its work: name one enemy rook or queen and it is slain where it stands.

rows.name: Eternal Reign
rows.effect: Your king gains permanent queen movement and cannot be captured for 3 turns.

rows.name: Fingertip Maltese
rows.effect: Elite fingertip hold on one enemy piece: it freezes for their next 3 turns and the eight squares around it are sealed, so nothing can rescue or relieve it.

rows.name: Full Rewind
rows.effect: Send up to five of your pieces back to their original home squares, once.

rows.name: Godslayer Knight
rows.effect: One knight moves as an amazon, is uncapturable, and explodes on capture, for 3 turns.

rows.name: Grand Nullify
rows.effect: Cancel your opponent's unused and temporary buffs. Locked-in upgrades resist.

rows.name: Grand Resurrection
rows.effect: Revive your queen and one minor piece to your half.

rows.name: Grand Retreat
rows.effect: Return your army to its free starting squares, once (blocked pieces stay put).

rows.name: Great Divide
rows.effect: One full rank you pick becomes impassable to enemies for the rest of the game.

rows.name: I Love My Sister
rows.effect: Bring your strongest fallen piece home to an empty square in your half. She arrives shielded, uncapturable for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Jackpot
rows.effect: Pull the lever for a one-in-two shot at a random apex card, one of the game's most powerful. Miss, and the consolation is still rich: your next draft rolls one tier higher and offers three cards instead of two.

rows.name: King's Legion
rows.effect: Add a rook, a knight, and a pawn to your pocket, then drop them onto empty squares on later turns.

rows.name: La Vaca Saturno Saturnita
rows.effect: The ringed cow swings into orbit: place a new knight on any empty square along the board's outer rim. While it settles into orbit it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns.

rows.name: Meteor
rows.effect: Destroy every enemy piece on one rank and one file that cross at a square you pick.

rows.name: Mind Empire
rows.effect: Take control of one enemy piece of any type below queen for the game.

rows.name: Necromancer
rows.effect: Raise your strongest fallen piece as a spectre on an empty square in your half. It fights for you, then crumbles to dust after 6 of your turns. If nothing of yours has been captured, nothing rises.

rows.name: Onslaught
rows.effect: The whole army surges: for your next 3 turns, every one of your knights, bishops, rooks, and queens can also step one square in any direction.

rows.name: Orb of Dominion
rows.effect: Take control of one enemy rook or queen for the rest of the game, once. While you still hold the dominated piece, the enemy queen cannot capture. Kings cannot be taken.

rows.name: Overclocked
rows.effect: Crank the clock speed: add 75 seconds to your own clock. Then everything runs hot and has to cool down, so for your next 3 turns all your pieces can move only one square.

rows.name: Phoenix Line
rows.effect: Revive all your captured pawns to your 2nd rank, once.

rows.name: Purge Realm
rows.effect: Remove every enemy minor piece from one half of the board.

rows.name: Queen's Rampage
rows.effect: In one move, your queen sweeps along one straight line you choose and removes every enemy piece on it; a friendly piece or an enemy king ends the line, once.

rows.name: Rift Storm
rows.effect: Teleport up to two of your pieces, your king aside, each to any empty square, then swap the squares of two enemy pieces caught in the churn, once.

rows.name: Roost of Rocs
rows.effect: Three titanic rocs descend and perch along the board's edge: place three knights on empty squares of the outer rim.

rows.name: Ruin
rows.effect: Clear all enemy pawns, and destroy one enemy minor piece (or a rook if they have no minor).

rows.name: Soul Harvest
rows.effect: Your queen captures every enemy piece along one diagonal in a single move; for each piece reaped, a friendly pawn rises on an empty square in your half, plus one bonus pawn, once.

rows.name: Sovereign Draft
rows.effect: Take both cards in your next draft.

rows.name: Summon Dragon
rows.effect: An actual dragon answers: place a new queen on an empty square in your half. Whenever she captures, she breathes fire: every enemy piece except a king on the 8 squares around her kill is also removed. Shielded pieces resist the flame.

rows.name: Time Freeze
rows.effect: Your opponent skips their next turn, then on their following turn every enemy piece except the king is frozen.

rows.name: Triple Amazon
rows.effect: All your knights become amazons for the game, and each may also pass through one friendly piece per move.

rows.name: Grand Dominion
rows.effect: Take control of one enemy rook or queen: it becomes yours, once.

rows.name: Warp Cataclysm
rows.effect: Teleport up to four of your pieces, your king aside, each to any empty square, once. Pawns stay off the first and last ranks.

rows.name: Warp Sovereign
rows.effect: Swap up to three pairs of your pieces, once. Stop after any pair.

rows.name: Genie Wish
rows.effect: You wished for a queen and the genie obliges, with a flourish of fine print: a new queen appears in your pocket, and a knight appears in your OPPONENT'S. Both drop onto empty squares on later turns.

rows.name: Landslide
rows.effect: The whole slope gives way: every enemy piece except the king is pushed one square back toward its own home rank. Pieces with no room behind them stand fast.

rows.name: Whiteout
rows.effect: A blizzard freezes every enemy piece except the king and pawns for their next 2 turns. The pawns can still trudge.

rows.name: World Lock
rows.effect: Seal the border: your opponent cannot move any piece into your half of the board for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Dug-In Defense
rows.effect: Dig three foxholes: choose up to three of your pieces; they cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns.

rows.name: High Ground
rows.effect: Choose one of your pieces: for the game it cannot be captured while it stands in your opponent's half.

rows.name: Absolute Nullify
rows.effect: Cancel your opponent's unused and temporary buffs and block their next draft, but they gain a reroll in return. Locked-in upgrades resist.

rows.name: Age of Heroes
rows.effect: For your next 2 turns the old songs come true: each of your knights, bishops, and rooks may also move like a queen.

rows.name: Amazon Army
rows.effect: All your knights and bishops become amazons for the game.

rows.name: Ban Hammer
rows.effect: Moderator privileges activated: point at one enemy knight, bishop, or rook, and EVERY enemy piece of that type is permanently banned from the board.

rows.name: Blitzkrieg
rows.effect: Take four moves in a row, once. You cannot capture the king during these bonus moves: your opponent replies first.

rows.name: Bombardiro Crocodilo
rows.effect: The bomber-croc drops its payload on a square: every enemy piece except a king in the 5 by 5 area centred on it (that square and the 24 around it) is destroyed.

rows.name: Buff Plunder
rows.effect: Steal three active buffs from your opponent. Locked-in upgrades stay put.

rows.name: Cataclysmic Meteor
rows.effect: Destroy every enemy piece within a 3x3 area you pick except the king.

rows.name: Celestial Alignment
rows.effect: The stars chart the light squares and hold everything found there: every enemy piece except the king standing on a light square is frozen for 3 of their turns.

rows.name: Check Out Our Socials
rows.effect: Go live to the whole board. Every enemy piece except the king freezes for their next 2 turns while your hyped-up side takes 2 extra moves right now.

rows.name: Divine Fortress
rows.effect: Every piece on your half of the board, your king aside, is uncapturable for 3 turns.

rows.name: Divine Right
rows.effect: For your next 5 turns your king may move and capture as a queen, and it cannot be captured.

rows.name: Draft Supremacy
rows.effect: Take both cards in each of your next two drafts while your opponent's next draft is skipped.

rows.name: Endless Turn
rows.effect: Take moves until you make a capture, once (minimum one move).

rows.name: Eternal Freeze
rows.effect: Turn every enemy knight, bishop, rook, and queen to stone for 3 of their turns: each can only shuffle one square at a time. Enemy pawns are left free.

rows.name: Extinction
rows.effect: Remove every enemy minor and pawn piece from the board.

rows.name: Full Resurrection
rows.effect: Revive your queen, both rooks, and one minor piece to your half.

rows.name: Genesis
rows.effect: Reset the entire board to the opening position, once. Every lingering effect is washed away.

rows.name: Grand Reset
rows.effect: Add replacements to your pocket until your army would be back to full starting strength, then drop them onto empty squares on later turns.

rows.name: Heaven's Wrath
rows.effect: The sky splits and three bolts of wrath descend: smite three enemy knights, bishops, rooks, or queens you name from the board.

rows.name: I Love My GF
rows.effect: Your whole army, king included, cannot be captured for your opponent's next 3 turns, and you take two extra moves right now.

rows.name: I Love Whimpering Audios
rows.effect: On each of your next 3 turns, the enemy queen, rook, bishop, or knight nearest your king is charmed and joins your army. Kings never fall for it.

rows.name: Immortal King
rows.effect: Your king cannot be captured for your opponent's next 8 turns. You can still lose by running out of moves.

rows.name: Mass Mind Control
rows.effect: Take control of two enemy pieces of any type below queen, for the game.

rows.name: Philosopher's Stone
rows.effect: Press the fabled stone to your ranks and transmute base metal to gold: three of your pawns become queens, once.

rows.name: Phoenix Rebirth
rows.effect: Revive every captured piece you have to your half, once.

rows.name: Queen Storm
rows.effect: Promote all your pawns on your 4th rank or beyond to queens.

rows.name: Reality Warp
rows.effect: Rewrite the rules of matter: any two of your pieces, king aside, become queens.

rows.name: Summoning Circle
rows.effect: Chalk the circle and speak a greater name: a summoned queen steps through onto any empty square and serves for 6 of your turns before the circle pulls her back.

rows.name: Sundering
rows.effect: Three files become impassable to enemies for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Time Lock
rows.effect: Lock your opponent's clock and hand: they skip their next turn, and their next draft is skipped, once.

rows.name: Time Prison
rows.effect: Your opponent skips their next three turns, but the prison is fragile: if you capture anything while it holds, it shatters and their remaining skipped turns are refunded.

rows.name: Titan
rows.effect: One piece gains amazon movement for the rest of the game and cannot be captured for your opponent's next 6 turns.

rows.name: Total Annihilation
rows.effect: Choose any square: every enemy piece except a king standing on it or beside it is removed from the board. Shielded pieces resist the blast.

rows.name: Total Atomic
rows.effect: Every capture by your pieces detonates two squares in every direction and each removed piece chains its own blast, for the game.

rows.name: Total Plunder
rows.effect: Steal all your opponent's active buffs except locked-in upgrades.

rows.name: Total Warp
rows.effect: Teleport your whole army except the king anywhere you like, once. Pawns stay off the first and last ranks.

rows.name: The Void Realm
rows.effect: Three squares you pick become voids for the game: any enemy piece except a king that enters one, or ends its move beside one, is swallowed.

rows.name: Stoneskin
rows.effect: Your whole army cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns, and every enemy piece standing next to one of your pieces is locked in place for its next turn.

rows.name: World End
rows.effect: The edges of the world crumble away: your opponent can never move onto the outer rim of the board again, for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Butterfingers
rows.effect: Your opponent's queen cannot capture for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Cold Feet
rows.effect: Your opponent's pawns cannot capture for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Cold Open
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot move their queen for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Cold Snap
rows.effect: Freeze one enemy piece (not the king) for 1 of its owner's turns.

rows.name: Crossed Wires
rows.effect: Your opponent's knights cannot capture for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Drawbridge
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot castle for their next 6 turns.

rows.name: Foggy Glasses
rows.effect: Your opponent's bishops cannot capture for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Heavy Boots
rows.effect: Your opponent's pawns cannot double-step for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Bad Omen
rows.effect: A dark omen is read over their camp: on your opponent's 3rd turn from now, it strikes, and for that one turn they may move only a pawn or their king. They can see it coming and set up around it.

rows.name: Cold Footprints
rows.effect: The ground remembers their tread: for your opponent's next 5 turns, whenever they move a piece, the square it left is frozen over for their following turn, and no enemy piece may step onto it. Retracing their own steps is what the curse hates most.

rows.name: Witch's Veto
rows.effect: The witch forbids revenge: for your opponent's next 4 turns, they cannot capture the piece you moved on your previous turn. Everything else is fair game: they can attack other pieces, or simply wait a turn for the veto to move on.

rows.name: No Retreat
rows.effect: A banner of no surrender is nailed up: for your opponent's next 5 turns, none of their pieces may move toward their own back rank (no retreating or sidestepping backward). They may advance or move straight across; the king is exempt, and a piece with no forward move is freed for that turn. Wait it out, or press forward on the curse's own terms.

rows.name: Overexertion
rows.effect: The curse hates a workhorse: for your opponent's next 5 turns, whenever they move the same piece they moved on their previous turn, it seizes up and is frozen for 1 of their turns. Simply alternating which piece they develop avoids it completely. Kings never seize.

rows.name: Toll Road
rows.effect: A toll is set on the border: for your opponent's next 6 turns, any turn they move a piece out of their own half and into yours, their following turn is taxed - they may move only a pawn or their king. Developing at home is free; invading costs a beat of tempo. Kings crossing pay the same toll.

rows.name: Wrong Foot
rows.effect: Their dance is thrown off: for your opponent's next 4 turns, each piece they move must land on a square of the opposite color to wherever they landed last turn (light, then dark, then light). Their king is exempt, and if no legal move fits the pattern they may move freely that turn. Plan the sequence and it costs nothing.

rows.name: Knock Knees
rows.effect: Your opponent's knights cannot land on the rim for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Molasses
rows.effect: Your opponent's queen slides at most 3 squares for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Royal Restraint
rows.effect: Your opponent's king cannot capture for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Slippery Grip
rows.effect: Your opponent's rooks slide at most 3 squares for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Stage Fright
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot promote a pawn for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Stiff Joints
rows.effect: Your opponent's queen cannot move diagonally for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Toll Gate
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot capture en passant for their next 6 turns.

rows.name: Blunted Lance
rows.effect: Your opponent's knights cannot land on any square defended by one of your pawns, for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Butter Bishops
rows.effect: Your opponent's bishops slide at most 2 squares for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Cut Purse
rows.effect: Steal one of your opponent's unspent cards of tier 1. Locked-in upgrades stay put.

rows.name: Gargoyles
rows.effect: Petrify one of your opponent's bishops for 3 of their turns: it can only shuffle one square at a time.

rows.name: Hard Reset
rows.effect: Turn it off and on again: your opponent's most advanced pawn is sent back to its starting square, if that square is free. Ties reboot the pawn nearest the a-file.

rows.name: Blood Price
rows.effect: A price is set on your blood: the next time your opponent captures one of your pieces within their next 6 turns, they must skip their following turn while the debt is collected. If they hold their blades for 6 turns, the price expires unpaid.

rows.name: The Long Road Home
rows.effect: Lay a calling on one enemy knight, bishop or rook: every move it makes must bring it closer to its own back rank. The curse lifts the moment it stands on that rank; otherwise it fades after 6 of their turns. Their other pieces are free; the victim can simply obey, stand still, or be played around.

rows.name: Tarnished Crown
rows.effect: Their coronations are cursed: for your opponent's next 6 turns, any pawn they promote arrives exhausted: the new piece is frozen for 2 of their turns the moment it is crowned. They can wait the curse out or pay the price knowingly.

rows.name: Binding Oath
rows.effect: Swear two enemy pieces to a pact of restraint: for your opponent's next 6 turns, so long as both still stand, neither of the pair may capture anything. The oath breaks the instant one of them leaves the board, freeing the survivor. They can trade one away to release the other, or simply attack with their other pieces. Kings cannot be sworn.

rows.name: Bloodlust
rows.effect: A taste for blood takes hold: for your opponent's next 4 turns, any piece that captures is seized by frenzy and, on their very next turn, must capture again if any capture is open to it. If that piece has no capture available, the frenzy passes and they move freely. Capturing with a piece that cannot follow up, or not capturing at all, keeps them in control.

rows.name: Handed Down
rows.effect: A clinging curse settles on one enemy piece: for your opponent's next 6 turns the bearer is hobbled and may move at most 2 squares at a time. Trading it away does not end the curse - the moment you capture the bearer, the curse leaps to whichever of their pieces is nearest. To be rid of it they must strand the bearer far from the rest of the army, then let it die alone. Kings never take it.

rows.name: Fifth Column
rows.effect: Turn one enemy pawn to your cause: it fights under your banner for your next 3 turns, then its conscience returns and it goes back to your opponent. You move it on your turns; if it is captured while it serves you, the plot simply ends. Kings and other pieces are beyond the recruiter's reach.

rows.name: Slow Poison
rows.effect: Slip poison into one enemy queen, rook or bishop. In 4 of their turns it withers a full rank: a queen sinks to a rook, a rook to a bishop, a bishop to a knight. One dose of blood is the antidote: if the poisoned piece captures anything before then, the poison is purged. They see the fuse the whole time - feed it a capture, trade the piece off, or let it wither.

rows.name: Lame Horses
rows.effect: Your opponent's knights go lame and refuse to turn around: they cannot move backward for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Leaden Queen
rows.effect: Your opponent's queen can only capture at arm's length: her captures must be exactly one square away, for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: No Man's Land
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot enter the four center squares (d4, e4, d5, e5) for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Pinned Down
rows.effect: Freeze one targeted enemy piece, never the king, for 2 of their turns. As it thaws it stays a heavy walnut for 1 more turn, able only to shuffle a single square.

rows.name: Rusted Hinges
rows.effect: Your opponent's rooks cannot capture for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Safe Passage
rows.effect: The roads along the edge are under truce: your opponent cannot capture anything standing on the outer rim of the board, for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Sealed Orders
rows.effect: Your opponent's next two draft offers contain no draft-manipulation cards.

rows.name: Seized Axles
rows.effect: Your opponent's rooks cannot move sideways for their next 4 turns: they may only slide up and down their own file.

rows.name: Short Leash
rows.effect: Your opponent's bishops cannot cross into your half of the board for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Stone Hooves
rows.effect: Petrify one of your opponent's knights for 3 of their turns: it can only shuffle one square at a time. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Timid King
rows.effect: Your opponent's king cannot end a move beside any of your pieces, for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Trench Line
rows.effect: Your opponent's pawns cannot advance for their next 3 turns. They may still capture diagonally.

rows.name: Shy Pieces
rows.effect: Your opponent's pieces are too shy to approach the crown: for their next 2 turns none of them may move onto a square touching your king.

rows.name: Allergies
rows.effect: One enemy piece other than the king comes down with the sniffles. On each of your opponent's next 3 turns there is a chance it sneezes and cannot move that turn. Their other pieces are unaffected.

rows.name: Anchored Rooks
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot move their rooks for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Basilisk's Gaze
rows.effect: Turn one enemy piece to stone: it becomes a walnut that can only shuffle one square at a time for 4 of their turns, and while petrified it cannot capture. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Blinkered Bishops
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot move their bishops for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Boneca Ambalabu
rows.effect: The tire-frog drags your opponent down: for their next 4 turns none of their pieces may move more than 1 square in a single move.

rows.name: Cream Pie
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot capture on their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Durian
rows.effect: Lob the king of fruits onto an empty square: for your opponent's next 3 turns no enemy piece may move onto a square next to it. The stench clears after that.

rows.name: Frostbite
rows.effect: Freeze one enemy piece you target for 3 of their turns. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Gorgon's Glance
rows.effect: Turn one enemy knight or bishop you target into a walnut: 2 of their turns if it stands in its own half, 4 if it was caught in yours, where the gaze is strongest.

rows.name: Gremlins
rows.effect: For their next 4 turns, your opponent's rooks can only move an even number of squares.

rows.name: Hobbled Cavalry
rows.effect: Your opponent's knights turn to walnuts for 2 of their turns: a walnut can only shuffle one square at a time.

rows.name: Curse of Recoil
rows.effect: Their weapons kick like cannons: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any piece of theirs that captures is flung straight back to the square it attacked from (the victim is still taken, but the ground is not). Captures that promote are too heavy to throw back.

rows.name: No Reins
rows.effect: Their long pieces bolt: for your opponent's next 4 turns, every bishop, rook or queen slide must run as far as the line allows: to the board's edge, into a capture, or right up against one of their own pieces. No stopping halfway. Knights, pawns and the king keep their footing.

rows.name: Tolling Bell
rows.effect: A cracked bell hangs over their army: starting with your opponent's next turn and on every second turn after (their 1st, 3rd and 5th), its toll deafens the long arms: their bishops, rooks and queen cannot move on tolling turns. On the quiet turns in between, everything moves freely. Fades after their 6th turn.

rows.name: War Rations
rows.effect: Their war chest is sealed to two requisitions: across your opponent's next 5 turns they may make at most 2 captures. Once both are spent, their army cannot capture at all until the curse ends. They pick which battles are worth the ration.

rows.name: Blood Bond
rows.effect: Bind two enemy pieces in a bond of shared pain: for your opponent's next 6 turns, whenever one of the pair captures anything, the other is frozen for 2 of their turns. They may march the pair around all they like; only fighting with one punishes the other. Trade either away and the bond is cut. Kings cannot be bound.

rows.name: Coronation Tax
rows.effect: Their crownings come with a hidden levy: for your opponent's next 6 turns, each time they promote a pawn, one of their other pieces (chosen by the curse) is called to the ceremony and frozen for 2 of their turns. The new-crowned piece is untouched; the cost is paid elsewhere in the army. Delay the promotion, or pay the levy knowingly. Kings never attend.

rows.name: Debtor's Mark
rows.effect: Mark one enemy piece as a debtor: for your opponent's next 6 turns, every turn they leave it standing idle it runs up one turn of debt (up to 4). The instant they finally move it, the debt comes due and it is frozen for that many of their turns, then the slate is cleared. Moving it every turn keeps the debt at zero; leaving it parked forever costs nothing but a dead piece. Kings keep no debts.

rows.name: Exile's Mark
rows.effect: Brand one enemy knight, bishop or rook as an exile: every move it makes must carry it closer to your side of the board, and if it has not set foot in your half within 6 of their turns, it crumbles to dust. The mark lifts the instant it stands in your half. They can march it forward into danger, trade it away, or spend the other pieces while it withers. Kings are never exiled.

rows.name: Jammed Portcullis
rows.effect: A hex sits over their castle gate for the next 10 of their turns: if your opponent castles, the portcullis jams behind them. Two of their turns later, the rook that castled grinds to a halt and is frozen for 3 of their turns. It is a delayed, fully visible price on castling; if they never castle, or accept a stranded rook, the curse simply idles. Kings are never frozen.

rows.name: Wandering Sentry
rows.effect: Conjure a spectral sentry that paces a rank in your opponent's half: the square it stands on is barred to their pieces, and every turn it steps one file across, turning back when it reaches the edge. It patrols for 5 of their turns, then dissolves. Its beat is fixed and fully visible - time your moves through the gap behind it.

rows.name: Leaden Crown
rows.effect: The crown is too heavy to march: for your opponent's next 4 turns their queen cannot move toward your side of the board. Sideways and homeward slides are free.

rows.name: No Trespass
rows.effect: A truce holds at the crossroads: your opponent cannot capture anything standing on the four center squares (d4, e4, d5, e5) for their next 5 turns.

rows.name: Pawn Nerf
rows.effect: Nerf your opponent's pawns: their two-square double step is removed for the rest of the game. Every enemy pawn crawls one square at a time.

rows.name: Petrified Towers
rows.effect: Turn one enemy rook you target into a walnut for 2 of their turns, and while the tower stands petrified your opponent cannot castle at all.

rows.name: Royal Duty
rows.effect: On your opponent's next turn they may move only their king.

rows.name: Rubber Chicken
rows.effect: Bonk one enemy piece with a rubber chicken. It is too embarrassed to move for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be bonked.

rows.name: Sown Salt
rows.effect: Your opponent's pawns are rooted in salted ground and cannot move at all, not even to capture, for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Spooked Steeds
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot move their knights for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Stinky
rows.effect: One enemy piece other than the king reeks: for your opponent's next 3 turns their other pieces cannot move onto any square adjacent to it. The smelly piece itself may still move anywhere.

rows.name: Trippi Troppi
rows.effect: The shrimp-cat scrambles their proprioception: up to 3 enemy pieces (never the king) grow stubby shrimp legs, and for their next 2 turns each can only shuffle one square at a time.

rows.name: Twist the Knife
rows.effect: Their drawback bites back: for your opponent's next 3 captures, the capturing piece is frozen for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Understaffed
rows.effect: Half the office calls in sick: for their next 2 turns your opponent cannot move any piece standing on files a through d.

rows.name: Wasted Hour
rows.effect: The officers argue all morning: on your opponent's next turn they may only move a pawn or their king.

rows.name: Backseat Driver
rows.effect: Someone will not stop yelling push a pawn: on your opponent's next turn they must move a pawn if any pawn of theirs can legally move.

rows.name: Stage Fright
rows.effect: The spotlight waits for her: the next time your opponent's queen moves, stage fright strikes and she freezes where she lands for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Abandoned Post
rows.effect: Nobody presses the attack: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any move toward your side of the board may cover at most 2 squares. Sideways moves and retreats keep their full range.

rows.name: Changeling
rows.effect: The cradle swap ran the other way: one enemy knight or bishop you choose was a changeling all along. The glamour breaks and it is just a pawn.

rows.name: Cryostasis
rows.effect: Flash-freeze one enemy piece you target: it and every enemy piece beside it are frozen for 1 of their turns. Kings are never frozen.

rows.name: Daniel Caesar
rows.effect: Smooth things over. For your opponent's next 3 turns none of their pieces may capture anything, so the board stays calm while you set up.

rows.name: Dead Letter
rows.effect: Your opponent's next draft is skipped, but they gain one reroll in return.

rows.name: Faerie Ring
rows.effect: A ring of pale mushrooms springs up around a square you choose: the 8 squares surrounding it are impassable to your opponent for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Fissure Field
rows.effect: The ground splits open behind the enemy army: your opponent cannot move any piece onto their own back rank for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Flypaper File
rows.effect: Coat one file in flypaper, visible to both players: for your next 6 turns, enemy pieces (kings excepted) that enter that file are stuck and cannot move for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Frozen Furrows
rows.effect: The ruts freeze over between hauls: for your opponent's next 6 turns, whenever they move a rook, their rooks cannot move at all on their following turn.

rows.name: Granite Towers
rows.effect: Your opponent's rooks turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns: a walnut is so heavy it can only shuffle one square at a time.

rows.name: Hard Frost
rows.effect: Freeze two enemy pieces you target so they cannot move for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Heavy Shackles
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot move their queen or their rooks for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Hex Doll
rows.effect: You bind a lock of horsehair to a little cloth doll: choose one enemy piece except a king. If it captures anything within their next 3 turns, the pin goes in and it is destroyed.

rows.name: Hot Potato
rows.effect: Curse one enemy piece other than the king into a hot potato: for their next 4 turns your opponent must move that piece if it has any legal move.

rows.name: Compounding Misery
rows.effect: Misery multiplies: freeze one enemy piece you target for 1 of their turns, plus 1 more turn for every other curse-effect already afflicting your opponent (each frozen or petrified piece, sealed ground, or royal edict), up to 4 turns total. Cast onto a clean board it is a small chill; stacked on other hexes it bites deep. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Twinned Torment
rows.effect: Stitch two enemy pieces into one fate: for your opponent's next 6 turns, whenever one of the bound pair moves, the other seizes up and is frozen for 1 turn. They can still use one of the two freely, but only by leaving its twin nailed down. A captured twin slips the bond and frees the other. Kings cannot be bound.

rows.name: Weight of Toil
rows.effect: The curse counts every errand: for your opponent's next 6 turns, any single piece that makes its third move in that time collapses under the toil and becomes a walnut for 2 of their turns (shuffling one square at a time). Spreading the work across the army avoids it entirely. Kings never collapse.

rows.name: The Witching Hour
rows.effect: Midnight creeps up on their army: for your opponent's next 4 turns, every piece they move is touched by the hour. When midnight strikes at the end of those 4 turns, all touched pieces freeze for 2 of their turns. Moving few pieces, or only ones they can spare, keeps the damage down.

rows.name: Aging Blade
rows.effect: Every kill costs them a little youth: for your opponent's next 6 turns, whenever a queen, rook or bishop captures, it ages one rank on the spot - a queen becomes a rook, a rook a bishop, a bishop a knight. Knights and pawns are already too humble to age, so trading with them is safe. Capturing with their heavy pieces slowly grinds the army down.

rows.name: Miasma
rows.effect: A sickly fog settles over their ranks: for your opponent's next 6 turns, each time they move a piece so it ends adjacent to another of their pieces, that piece breathes in the miasma and grows more sick. On its third breath it succumbs and is frozen for 2 of their turns, and its lungs clear again. Keeping their pieces spread apart is the whole cure. Kings do not sicken.

rows.name: Mutiny
rows.effect: Sow mutiny in the cavalry: for your opponent's next 6 turns, the first time one of their knights captures a piece, it turns its coat on the spot and fights for you for your next 3 turns, then rides back to them. They can deny it by capturing with anything but a knight, or by keeping their knights out of the fray. If it is captured while it serves you, the mutiny simply ends.

rows.name: Forced Pilgrimage
rows.effect: Lay a geas on one enemy piece and name a shrine square it must reach: if that piece stands on the shrine within 6 of their turns, the geas lifts. If the deadline passes and it has not, the piece collapses in exhaustion and is frozen for 3 of their turns. Its other pieces are free; the victim can walk the pilgrim to the shrine, trade it, or let it fall. Kings take no geas.

rows.name: Sinking Mire
rows.effect: Conjure a sucking mire in your opponent's half: a cross of five squares no enemy piece may step onto (pieces caught inside may still climb out). Unlike a spreading rot the mire drains away, losing one arm of the cross on each of their turns until nothing is left, over 5 of their turns. Route around the puddle and wait it out, or fight past its edge.

rows.name: Powder Keg
rows.effect: Roll a powder keg onto an empty square in your opponent's half with a lit 4-turn fuse, in full view. When the fuse burns out, it detonates: every enemy piece (except the king) standing on or next to that square is blown off the board. The count is on the card the whole time - clear their pieces out of the blast before it goes, or lose whatever lingers.

rows.name: Ironbound Rook
rows.effect: Bind one enemy rook to its rank: for 4 of their turns it cannot leave the rank it stands on. It may still slide sideways.

rows.name: Lost Weekend
rows.effect: Your opponent skips their next turn, and their clock loses 20 seconds.

rows.name: Medusa's Stare
rows.effect: Turn one enemy queen you target into a walnut for 3 of their turns: a walnut is so heavy it can only shuffle one square at a time.

rows.name: Mute Button
rows.effect: You mute the loudest voices in their army: for their next 3 turns your opponent's queen and rooks cannot capture.

rows.name: Opposite Day
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns, they cannot move any piece closer to your king. Moves that keep the same distance are allowed. If that would leave them with no legal move, the restriction is lifted for that turn.

rows.name: Origami
rows.effect: Your opponent's rooks are folded into paper cranes: they may move at most 1 square for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Patch Notes
rows.effect: The balance patch lands: your opponent's next draft is skipped, and you gain one draft reroll.

rows.name: Puck's Mischief
rows.effect: A hobgoblin ties every royal shoelace together: for their next 3 turns your opponent's queen and rooks may move only one square at a time.

rows.name: Sealed Gate
rows.effect: Brick up one gate of your choosing: pick any square, and your opponent cannot move any piece onto that square's entire file for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Serpent Brood
rows.effect: Venomous stone serpents coil around the enemy clergy: every one of your opponent's bishops turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns, and the venom lingers so no enemy bishop may capture for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Shackle the Queen
rows.effect: Bind the enemy queen in cursed iron: your opponent cannot move their queen for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Skill Issue
rows.effect: Diagnosis delivered: their minor pieces whiff every attack: enemy knights and bishops cannot capture for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Statue Stable
rows.effect: Your opponent's knights turn to walnuts for 2 of their turns, and your own knights harden into living statues: they cannot be captured for those same 2 turns.

rows.name: Stone Clergy
rows.effect: Your opponent's bishops turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns: a walnut is so heavy it can only shuffle one square at a time.

rows.name: Vertigo
rows.effect: The whole room tilts sideways: for their next 2 turns your opponent may only make diagonal moves. Their king keeps its footing and may still step anywhere.

rows.name: Jinx
rows.effect: The jinx sours every friendship: for their next 2 turns, your opponent's pieces cannot end a move on a square beside another of their own pieces.

rows.name: Riptide
rows.effect: A countercurrent runs through the middle of the board: for your opponent's next 3 turns, any enemy piece except the king that ends its move on the 4th or 5th rank is dragged one square back toward its home rank, when that square is free.

rows.name: Ball and Chain
rows.effect: Their drawback grows teeth: for your opponent's next 5 turns, the piece they just moved must rest a turn before moving again.

rows.name: Burned Dispatches
rows.effect: Your opponent's next draft is skipped outright, and the draft after that arrives nullified and inert.

rows.name: Cast a Nerf
rows.effect: Cast a nerf on your opponent: they cannot capture for their next 2 turns, and their next drafted card arrives nullified.

rows.name: Chains of Binding
rows.effect: A spectral chain shackles the enemy's rooks to each other: while both live, neither rook may end a move more than 3 squares from the other, for your opponent's next 5 turns. A lone rook drags its broken chain and moves freely.

rows.name: Curse of Frailty
rows.effect: A wasting curse saps the enemy's strength: for their next 3 turns your opponent cannot capture, and no piece of theirs may slide more than two squares.

rows.name: Divine Reckoning
rows.effect: The verdict is exile: choose one enemy piece except the king. If one of its own starting squares is free it is sent back there (nearest the a-file first); either way it is frozen for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Doom March
rows.effect: The march ends where it stands: enemy pieces that have crossed into your half of the board are gripped by dread and cannot move, for your opponent's next 4 turns.

rows.name: Frost Wall
rows.effect: A wall of blue ice seals the keep: your opponent cannot move any piece onto your back two ranks for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Frozen Moment
rows.effect: The next piece your opponent moves freezes solid the instant it lands and cannot move again for 3 of their turns.

rows.name: Granite Ramparts
rows.effect: Your opponent's rooks turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns, and for their next 2 turns they cannot move any piece onto their own back two ranks.

rows.name: Hexed Satchel
rows.effect: Your opponent's next 2 drafted cards arrive nullified and do nothing.

rows.name: Homesick
rows.effect: Your opponent's army is homesick: every piece may only move toward or along its own back rank for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Chains of the Court
rows.effect: Your opponent's knights and bishops are chained into stone for 4 of their turns (walnuts that shuffle one square at a time). The chains have a lock: if their KING steps onto one of the four center squares (d4, e4, d5, e5) while the curse holds, every petrified courtier is freed at once. Wait it out in safety, or walk the king into the open to break it early.

rows.name: Creeping Blight
rows.effect: Blight one square in your opponent's half of the board: no enemy piece may move onto blighted ground (pieces already standing there may still leave). On each of their next turns the blight creeps to one more adjacent square in their half, for 5 of their turns, then the whole patch withers away. Play around the spread, or stay out of its half entirely.

rows.name: Cursed Coin
rows.effect: Press a cursed coin into one enemy piece's hand: for your opponent's next 8 turns the holder cannot capture and can move at most 2 squares. The coin is eager to be passed: whenever the holder ends a move beside another of their pieces, or one of their pieces ends a move beside the holder, the coin jumps to that piece. Quarantining the holder away from the army contains it; capturing the holder yourself destroys the coin. Kings never take the coin.

rows.name: Queen's Ransom
rows.effect: A ransom is set on her majesty's steps: for your opponent's next 5 turns, each time they move their queen, two other pieces of theirs (chosen by the curse) are seized as surety and frozen for 1 turn. The queen herself is never restrained: benching her costs nothing, using her taxes the court.

rows.name: Bounty Mark
rows.effect: Paint a bounty on one enemy piece for the next 6 of their turns: whenever the marked piece captures anything, it is swarmed by bounty hunters and frozen for 2 of their turns afterward. Marching it around is free; only using it to fight is punished. They can keep it out of combat, or trade it away to shed the mark. Kings carry no bounty.

rows.name: Collapsing Floor
rows.effect: Curse one rank in your opponent's half with a slow crack: after 3 of their turns the floor gives way, and every piece of theirs still standing on that rank is caught in the rubble and frozen for 2 of their turns. Their king is never trapped. The rank and the count are both plain to read - march their pieces off it before it caves in.

rows.name: Sleeper Cell
rows.effect: Plant a sleeper in one enemy knight or bishop. On their 4th turn from now it wakes and defects: it becomes yours to command for your next 3 turns, then slips back to your opponent. Until it turns, it is still theirs - they can root out the plot by capturing or trading the marked piece before the fuse ends. Kings are never turned.

rows.name: Roaming Maw
rows.effect: Tear open a hungry void in your opponent's half. Each of their turns it drifts one square toward their nearest piece, and no enemy piece may move onto the square it occupies. If it reaches a piece (never the king), that piece is swallowed off the board. It hunts for 6 of their turns, then closes. Its next step is always plain to see - keep pieces clear of its path.

rows.name: Shared Fate
rows.effect: Stitch the fates of two enemy pieces together for the next 8 of their turns: if you capture one of the pair, the other drops dead in the same instant, wherever it stands. They can break the link by trading one of the two away themselves, or by keeping the pair well guarded so you never take either. A king can never be fate-bound.

rows.name: Wildfire Rot
rows.effect: Set a rot on one enemy piece: for your opponent's next 6 turns, no rotten piece may capture, and on each of their turns the rot spreads to one more of their pieces standing beside an infected one. Left in a huddle it consumes the whole cluster; kept apart it cannot jump the gap. Capturing a rotten piece burns that infection away. Kings never rot.

rows.name: Iron Furrow
rows.effect: The field is sown with iron spikes: your opponent's pawns cannot advance for their next 4 turns, and any enemy pawn that captures during that time is caught on the spikes, unable to move for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Lava Floor
rows.effect: A whole rank erupts into lava: pick any square and its entire rank is barred to your opponent for their next 4 turns, and the eruption throws every enemy piece already on that rank one square back toward its home rank.

rows.name: Lone Sovereign
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns they may move only their king and their knights. Every other piece is stuck fast.

rows.name: Medusa's Verdict
rows.effect: Your opponent's queen turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns, and every enemy piece standing next to her is frozen for 1 of their turns.

rows.name: Palsied Hands
rows.effect: Their hands shake after every kill: for your opponent's next 6 turns, they cannot capture on two turns in a row.

rows.name: Peasant Levy
rows.effect: The levy defends only the homeland: for your opponent's next 3 turns they may move only pieces standing in their own half of the board. Anything already across the middle is stranded.

rows.name: Queen's Handicap
rows.effect: Nerf your opponent's queen: for their next 4 turns her every move must end beside another of their own pieces. No escort, no move.

rows.name: Royal Handicap
rows.effect: Nerf the crown itself: the patch removes diagonal movement from your opponent's king for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Royal Summons
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 2 turns, they must move their king if it has a legal move.

rows.name: Rust
rows.effect: Idle enemy pieces seize up: any enemy piece (never a king) that has stood still for 2 of your opponent's turns rusts solid and may only move if the move is a capture, until it finally moves.

rows.name: Bobrito Bandito
rows.effect: Bonk one enemy piece with the log: it is stunned and cannot move for its next 2 turns. Kings are too stubborn to bonk.

rows.name: Scorched Middle
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot enter any square on the 4th or 5th ranks for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Stone Curse
rows.effect: Turn one enemy piece you target into a walnut for 4 of their turns: it can only shuffle one square at a time. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Stone Menagerie
rows.effect: Petrify two enemy minor pieces you target (knights or bishops) for 3 of their turns.

rows.name: Thorn Hedge
rows.effect: A hedge of black thorns walls off your realm: enemy bishops, rooks, and queens cannot cross into your half of the board for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Throne Bound
rows.effect: The queen may not stray from her king: for your opponent's next 4 turns, her every move must end within 2 squares of their king.

rows.name: Walnut Curse
rows.effect: Their greed turns to wood: for your opponent's next 2 captures, the capturing piece becomes a walnut for 3 of their turns, able only to shuffle one square at a time. Kings shrug the curse off.

rows.name: Broken Elevator
rows.effect: The lift to your half is out of order: for their next 2 turns your opponent cannot move any piece onto either of your two back ranks.

rows.name: Wrong Way
rows.effect: Every one of your opponent's pieces has its map upside down: for their next 2 turns none of them may retreat toward their own back rank.

rows.name: Withering Touch
rows.effect: One enemy piece freezes solid for 3 of their turns, then withers to a walnut that can only shuffle one square at a time for the rest of the game. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Court in Exile
rows.effect: On your opponent's next 2 turns they may move only their king, and their queen is the last to return from exile: she cannot move for 2 further turns after the court comes back.

rows.name: Creeping Frost
rows.effect: Freeze three enemy pieces (not the king) for 2 of their owner's turns.

rows.name: Empty Handed
rows.effect: Your opponent's next draft is blocked and skipped, and every draft reroll they still hold is stolen and added to yours.

rows.name: Eternal Statue
rows.effect: Turn one enemy piece you target into a walnut for the rest of the game: it can only shuffle one square at a time. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Glacial Flanks
rows.effect: Freeze your opponent's knights and bishops for 2 of their turns.

rows.name: Grounded Command
rows.effect: The heavy pieces are grounded: for your opponent's next 4 turns their queen and rooks cannot move onto any square in your half of the board. They move freely within their own.

rows.name: Groundhog Day
rows.effect: The board hits a VHS rewind on your opponent: whichever piece they move on their next turn, they must move that same piece again on the two turns after. If that piece can no longer move, the loop is skipped.
