rows.name: Gathering Storm
rows.effect: A storm gathers over their army and worsens every two turns, for your opponent's next 6 turns. Turns 1 and 2: their pawns cannot advance (captures still allowed). Turns 3 and 4: their knights and bishops also cannot cross into your half. Turns 5 and 6: their bishops, rooks and queen are also capped at 2 squares per move. Then it breaks all at once. The early turns are the time to act.

rows.name: Gilded Rot
rows.effect: Whatever they touch turns to gold: for your opponent's next 5 turns, each piece they move is gilded, and gilded pieces cannot capture for the rest of the curse. Unmoved pieces keep their teeth, so they must choose between developing their game and keeping their army dangerous. When the curse ends the gold flakes off everything at once.

rows.name: Gravebloom
rows.effect: Flowers with long memories: for your opponent's next 6 turns, every square where they capture becomes a grave-garden for 3 of their turns: the capturing piece may leave, but no enemy piece may move onto that square while it blooms. Each kill costs them the ground it was won on; capturing less, or only on squares they don't need, is the way through.

rows.name: Avalanche
rows.effect: Snow gathers silently over their half for 3 of their turns, then comes down all at once. For the 3 turns after it falls, their pieces may not move onto any empty square in their own half - only captures and moves into your half remain. Whatever ground they already hold is safe footing, so spreading out before it drops is the counter. If it ever leaves them no move, they play freely that turn.

rows.name: Doomed Vow
rows.effect: Condemn one enemy piece with a vow only their king can answer: in 5 of their turns it is dragged off the board, unless their own king comes to stand on a square next to it before then, which breaks the vow at once. Their king must leave shelter to save it - or they abandon the piece and keep the king safe. The count is on the card throughout. Kings themselves cannot be condemned.

rows.name: Effigy of Dread
rows.effect: Raise a leering effigy on an empty square in your opponent's half. While it stands, every square around it is barred to their pieces, and the dread lingers for 6 of their turns before it topples. It is not invincible: the effigy is a piece they can capture, and smashing it ends the curse at once. Route around its shadow, or send a piece to break it.

rows.name: Feeding Frenzy
rows.effect: A parasite curse that feeds on other curses: for your opponent's next 6 turns, their bishops, rooks and queen have their reach capped, and the cap tightens for every other curse-effect already afflicting them (each frozen or petrified piece, sealed square, or royal edict). On a clean board it barely bites; on a board buried in hexes it clamps their long pieces to a crawl. Cleansing the other curses loosens this one.

rows.name: Hydra Hex
rows.effect: Brand one enemy piece as the hydra's head, for the next 8 of their turns. If you cut it off (capture the branded piece), two heads grow back: the two enemy pieces nearest where it fell are frozen for 2 of their turns each. Leaving the head alone lets the curse expire harmlessly; capturing it while it stands alone, far from help, gives the new heads nothing to seize. Kings are neither head nor spawn.

rows.name: Standing Guard
rows.effect: A cruel duty binds their bodyguard: for your opponent's next 6 turns, every time their king moves, whichever of their pieces stands nearest the king is frozen in place for 1 of their turns, rooted to watch over the empty throne. Keeping the king still keeps the guard free. The king itself is never frozen.

rows.name: Kraken
rows.effect: A kraken surfaces on an empty square. For your opponent's next 3 turns, at the end of each of their turns it drags the nearest enemy piece one square toward it whenever the square between is empty, then seizes any enemy piece left next to it so that piece cannot move on its next turn. Kings are never dragged or seized, and the kraken's square cannot be entered.

rows.name: Leaden Fields
rows.effect: Their pawns are cast in lead: every advanced enemy pawn first sinks one square back toward home (if that square is free), and then their pawns cannot move at all, not even to capture, for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Lost Days
rows.effect: Your opponent skips their next 2 turns entirely.

rows.name: Lunar Eclipse
rows.effect: The moon slides into shadow and the enemy's great powers still with it: your opponent's rooks and queen cannot move for 3 of their turns.

rows.name: Nerf Hammer
rows.effect: Bring down the nerf hammer: turn one enemy knight, bishop, or rook you target into a walnut for 2 of their turns. It can only shuffle one square at a time.

rows.name: Nerf This
rows.effect: The balance team finally answers: one enemy queen you point at is patched down to a bishop where she stands.

rows.name: Queen of Stone
rows.effect: The curse waits in her shoes: the next time your opponent moves their queen, she turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns the moment she lands.

rows.name: Sealed Avenues
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot enter any square on the d or e files for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Stone Bastions
rows.effect: Your opponent's rooks turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns, and each stone bastion seals its ground: for their next 3 turns your opponent cannot move any piece onto the files their petrified rooks stand on.

rows.name: Stone Prelates
rows.effect: The pews claim whoever lingers: for your opponent's next 6 turns, any of their bishops standing in their own half may only shuffle one square at a time. Bishops that cross into your half move freely.

rows.name: Stone Riders
rows.effect: Your opponent's knights turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns, and the stone is catching: on each of those turns one random enemy piece standing beside a stone rider is petrified for 1 turn too.

rows.name: Termites
rows.effect: Termites gnaw at your opponent's towers: every 2 of their turns, their rooks lose one more square of reach. The decay stops at a reach of 1, so a rook can always shuffle a single square.

rows.name: The Big Chill
rows.effect: Freeze all of your opponent's pieces except their king for 3 of their turns, but the thaw is uneven: at the end of each of their turns, one random frozen piece shakes free of the ice early.

rows.name: Total Whiteout
rows.effect: A blizzard buries every sightline: for their next 3 turns, your opponent's pieces can only capture at arm's length, exactly one square away.

rows.name: Wall of Thorns
rows.effect: A thicket of undying thorns bursts up around an empty square: your opponent can never enter any of the 8 squares around it, for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Sticky Floor
rows.effect: The whole floor is flypaper: every one of your opponent's pieces may move at most one square for their next 2 turns.

rows.name: Hellfire Beam
rows.effect: The beam scorches an X across the board: pick any square, and both diagonals through it stay burning: your opponent cannot move onto them for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Chisel Curse
rows.effect: Turn one enemy piece you target into a walnut for 4 of their turns, and the enemy pieces directly to its left and right into walnuts for 2 of their turns each. Kings are never affected.

rows.name: Cockatrice Gaze
rows.effect: Every enemy knight and bishop standing in your half of the board turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns. The minors still in their own half only catch the reflection: they are frozen for 1 turn.

rows.name: Contagion
rows.effect: Freezes are catching: whenever one of your opponent's pieces is newly frozen, one adjacent enemy piece (never a king) catches it and is frozen for 2 of their turns. Each fresh freeze spreads at most one square, so it never runs away.

rows.name: Frozen Solid
rows.effect: Freeze one enemy piece you target and one enemy piece standing next to it for 3 of their turns each. Kings cannot be chosen.

rows.name: Glacial Tomb
rows.effect: Freeze all of your opponent's pieces except their king for 2 of their turns. As the ice melts each one becomes a walnut for 2 more turns, able to shuffle only one square at a time.

rows.name: Grand Malediction
rows.effect: Your opponent skips their next turn, and the next card they draft arrives nullified and inert.

rows.name: Hex of Stone
rows.effect: A creeping grey hex hardens the enemy's flanks: every one of your opponent's knights and bishops turns to a walnut for 4 of their turns, and for those 4 turns their rooks and queen may slide no more than two squares.

rows.name: Death Knell
rows.effect: Toll the knell over one enemy piece you target: in 4 of their turns it crumbles to dust and is removed. The bell accepts one bribe: if the doomed piece captures anything before the last toll, the curse breaks and it lives. Your opponent sees the count the whole time: they can feed the bell a pawn, spend the piece in a trade, or gamble on saving it. Kings cannot be tolled.

rows.name: The Hollow Crown
rows.effect: The crown itself is cursed, for the rest of the game: whenever your opponent's king moves (castling included), the court mourns: on their FOLLOWING turn they may move only pawns or the king. The curse sleeps as long as the king holds still, so they must choose between a frozen throne and a stumbling court every time the king needs to act.

rows.name: Tide of Ash
rows.effect: Ash rolls in over their homeland: their 1st rank is buried at once, and the tide swallows one more of their home ranks on each of their next 3 turns, up to their 4th rank. Buried ground cannot be moved ONTO by your opponent (pieces standing in the ash may still climb out), so their army is herded forward rank by rank. The whole tide blows away after their 6th turn.

rows.name: The Long Eclipse
rows.effect: A shadow crosses the sun over their army. For their first 3 turns nothing seems wrong, then the eclipse falls: for the following 3 of their turns their bishops and queen are blind and cannot move at all. The knights, rooks, pawns and king see fine throughout. The schedule is fixed - use the diagonal pieces before the dark, and rely on the others during it.

rows.name: The Enemy Within
rows.effect: Whisper treason to one enemy rook or queen. Over the next 8 of their turns, the third time they move that piece, its patience snaps and it defects: it serves you for your next 4 turns, then returns to them. Working it hard is what turns it - they can leave it standing, or trade it away, to keep it loyal. If it is captured while it fights for you, the treason ends. Kings never turn.

rows.name: Pyrrhic Toll
rows.effect: Victory itself is cursed: for your opponent's next 6 turns, each time any of their pieces captures, the army mourns and one of their other pieces (chosen by the curse) is frozen for 1 of their turns. Every kill they take costs them a beat somewhere else on the board. Refusing trades avoids the toll entirely; a grinding, capture-heavy game bleeds them dry. Kings never mourn.

rows.name: Lost Fortnight
rows.effect: Your opponent skips their next turn, their next draft is skipped, and 20 seconds are struck off their clock.

rows.name: Molten Heart
rows.effect: Their blades run molten: for your opponent's next 2 captures, the capturing piece is destroyed along with its victim. Kings burn nothing and are never destroyed.

rows.name: Noble Rout
rows.effect: The nobles break and run: for your opponent's next 3 turns their knights, bishops, rooks and queen cannot move toward your side of the board. Only their pawns and king may still advance.

rows.name: Obsidian Bastions
rows.effect: Your opponent's rooks turn to walnuts for 4 of their turns, and from then on those rooks can never capture again for the rest of the game.

rows.name: Salted Earth
rows.effect: Your opponent's pawns can never advance again for the rest of the game; they may still capture diagonally. On top of that, for their next 3 turns they cannot move any piece onto their own 4th rank.

rows.name: Sealed Archive
rows.effect: Your opponent's next draft is skipped entirely, and the draft after that is forced to roll at tier 1: only the dregs seep out of a sealed vault.

rows.name: Statue Garden
rows.effect: Your opponent's knights and bishops turn to walnuts for 3 of their turns: a walnut is so heavy it can only shuffle one square at a time.

rows.name: Throne and Silence
rows.effect: For your opponent's next turn they may move only their king, and their next draft is skipped entirely.

rows.name: Walnut Court
rows.effect: The whole court hardens where it sits: every enemy piece except the king still on its own back rank turns into a walnut for 3 of their turns. A walnut can only shuffle one square at a time.

rows.name: Withered Hands
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot capture with any piece for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Abdication Edict
rows.effect: For your opponent's next 3 turns they may move only their king. Every other piece is stuck fast.

rows.name: Absolute Zero
rows.effect: Freeze all of your opponent's pieces except their king for 2 of their turns. The cold outlives the ice: for their next 2 turns after the thaw, every piece they move can only step a single square.

rows.name: Blighted Furrows
rows.effect: The blight takes whatever ripened first: every enemy pawn standing in your half of the board rots away and is removed, and their remaining pawns cannot advance for their next 4 turns.

rows.name: Crown and Castle
rows.effect: Your opponent's queen and rooks turn to walnuts for 2 of their turns: a walnut is so heavy it can only shuffle one square at a time.

rows.name: Endless Night
rows.effect: Your opponent skips their next 2 turns. On the turn they finally return, every enemy piece except their king is frozen for that one turn, so only their king may move.

rows.name: Everfrost Shard
rows.effect: Freeze one enemy piece you target for 4 of their turns. The shard radiates: for those 4 turns your opponent cannot move any piece onto a square beside it. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Beacon of Woe
rows.effect: Light a doom-beacon on one of your OWN pieces, in full view of both players: when your opponent's 6th turn from now ends, every enemy knight, bishop, rook and queen is frozen for 2 of their turns. Snuffing the flame is the only cure: if they capture the beacon-bearer before it strikes, the curse dies with it. You must keep the bearer alive for six turns; they must decide whether to spend those turns hunting it.

rows.name: Crown of Thorns
rows.effect: A briar is woven around your king, in full view: for your opponent's next 6 turns, any enemy piece whose move leaves your king in check is seized by the thorns and frozen for 2 of their turns where it stands. The check still counts, but the attacker is rooted, and the follow-up must come from somewhere else. Attacking anything BUT your king costs them nothing.

rows.name: Pauper's Crown
rows.effect: Strip the crown from their queen: she is humbled into a ROOK for 4 of their turns, then restored. Blood restores pride sooner: the moment she captures anything while humbled, she becomes a queen again on the spot. She still fights as a full rook the whole time, and if she is captured while humbled she is simply lost as a rook. Requires an enemy queen on the board.

rows.name: Blood Tithe
rows.effect: A tithe is levied on every kill: for your opponent's next 6 turns, whenever they capture anything larger than a pawn, one of their own pawns (chosen by the curse) is claimed as tribute and removed from the board. Trading pawn for pawn is untaxed; every heavier trade quietly costs them a pawn on top. Once they have no pawns left, the tithe goes unpaid. Refusing trades starves it entirely.

rows.name: The Curse Engine
rows.effect: A grinding machine of malice runs over their army for the next 9 of their turns. Every turn it winds one notch tighter; on every third notch it discharges, freezing whichever of their pieces is strongest for 2 of their turns, then resets. It cannot be reasoned with, only outlasted - three discharges across its life, each snuffing their best piece for a spell. Their king is never seized.

rows.name: The Inverted Crown
rows.effect: The rules of coronation are turned upside down: for your opponent's next 6 turns, any pawn that reaches the last rank is crowned not as they choose but as a mere knight, no matter what they promote to. A knight is still a piece, but never the queen they hoped for. Holding a pawn back until the curse lifts restores a proper coronation.

rows.name: Martyr's Crown
rows.effect: A patient briar guards your king for your opponent's next 6 turns. A single check passes unpunished, but on the second time they place your king in check, the thorns lash out: every enemy piece standing next to your king is frozen for 2 of their turns, and the count resets. Persistent, hammering checks are what trigger it - a single decisive check, or threats aimed elsewhere, cost them nothing.

rows.name: Leaden Limbs
rows.effect: Your opponent may move each piece at most one square in any direction for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Basilisk's Stare
rows.effect: Turn one enemy piece you target into a walnut for the rest of the game: it can only ever shuffle one square at a time. Its gaze lingers, so any enemy piece that ends a move next to the statue is frozen for 1 of their turns. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Peace of the Grave
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot capture with any piece for their next 3 turns, and for those turns they cannot move any piece onto a square next to your king.

rows.name: Petrified Forest
rows.effect: Your opponent's knights and bishops turn to walnuts for 4 of their turns, and the forest has roots: any enemy piece that ends a move beside one of the stone trees is entangled and frozen for 1 turn.

rows.name: Poisoned Counsel
rows.effect: Your opponent's next drafted card arrives nullified and does nothing, and the venom drawn from their counsel sweetens yours: your next draft rolls one tier higher.

rows.name: Sacked Capital
rows.effect: Your opponent skips their next 2 turns entirely, and their next draft is skipped as well.

rows.name: Scorched Earth
rows.effect: Your opponent cannot move any piece onto their own 4th, 5th, or 6th ranks for their next 3 turns.

rows.name: Sealed Ramparts
rows.effect: Your opponent's rooks can never move again for the rest of the game. Their other pieces are unaffected.

rows.name: Walnut Shell
rows.effect: Crack it open: free one of your pieces from any freeze or walnut hex.

rows.name: Apple
rows.effect: Feed one of your pieces: it cannot be captured for your opponent's next 2 turns and may immediately step one square to an empty square beside it.

rows.name: Banana Peel
rows.effect: Toss peels on two empty squares, visible to both players. The first enemy piece other than the king to step on each slips one square back toward its home rank and is too dazed to move on its owner's next turn.

rows.name: Coconut Bonk
rows.effect: Drop a coconut on one enemy piece: it is stunned and cannot move for its next turn. Kings are too hard-headed.

rows.name: Evil Eye
rows.effect: One enemy piece you choose cannot capture anything for 4 of their turns. It may still move. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Fly Swatter
rows.effect: One enemy knight is stunned for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Rake
rows.effect: One wide swing: every enemy pawn standing beside a piece you choose is raked one square back toward its home rank, wherever that square is free.

rows.name: Snowball
rows.effect: One enemy pawn is frozen for 3 of their turns.

rows.name: Whoopee Cushion
rows.effect: Hide a whoopee cushion on an empty square. The first enemy piece other than the king to land on it makes a rude noise and must move that same piece again on their next 2 turns. Then the cushion is done.

rows.name: Anvil Drop
rows.effect: Drop an ACME anvil on one enemy piece: it is flattened and cannot move for 3 of their turns, and the impact knocks it one square back toward its home rank. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Boxing Glove
rows.effect: A spring-loaded glove punches one enemy piece one square back toward its own side and stuns it for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be targeted.

rows.name: Magnet
rows.effect: Drag one enemy piece (not the king) one square toward your king.

rows.name: Napping
rows.effect: The enemy piece farthest from its own king sneaks a nap while nobody is watching: it is frozen for 3 of their turns. Kings never nap; ties pick the square nearest a1.

rows.name: Super Glue
rows.effect: Empty the tube on one enemy piece: it and every enemy piece orthogonally next to it are stuck fast and cannot move for 2 of their turns. Kings cannot be targeted or stuck.

rows.name: Trampoline
rows.effect: Bounce one of your pieces (not the king) to any empty square within two squares of it.

rows.name: Bear Trap
rows.effect: Hide a bear trap on an empty square, visible only in your nightmares: the first enemy piece except a king to step onto it is snapped up and cannot move for 4 of their turns.

rows.name: Coffee
rows.effect: Knock it back: take two extra moves right now, but the jitters hand your opponent one extra move on their reply.

rows.name: Firecracker
rows.effect: Startle one enemy piece (not the king): it retreats one square toward its home rank.

rows.name: Cess
rows.effect: You can't move to the h-file.

rows.name: Escort Mission
rows.effect: If your king can capture, it must.

rows.name: Flat Footed
rows.effect: Your pawns can't advance two squares.

rows.name: Homebody King
rows.effect: Your king can't leave your first two ranks.

rows.name: Keep Off the Grass
rows.effect: Your king can't move onto the four center squares.

rows.name: Knights Off the Rail
rows.effect: Your knights can't move to the a-file or h-file.

rows.name: Level Headed
rows.effect: Your queen can't move diagonally more than 3 squares.

rows.name: Lucky
rows.effect: You have no nerf. A rare gift from the gods of chess.

rows.name: No Drawbridge
rows.effect: You can't castle.

rows.name: Squeamish
rows.effect: Your pawns can't make the game's first capture.

rows.name: No Stone Cutting
rows.effect: You can't capture bishops.

rows.name: Gentle Shepherds
rows.effect: Your bishops can't capture pawns.

rows.name: Late Riser
rows.effect: Your queen can't move during your first four moves. From your fifth move on she is free.

rows.name: Opening Ceremony
rows.effect: Your very first move of the game must be a pawn move.

rows.name: Silent Infantry
rows.effect: Your pawns can't give check: any pawn move that would leave the enemy king in check is forbidden. A pawn may still capture the king itself.

rows.name: Pen Pusher
rows.effect: Your rooks can't capture.

rows.name: Quit Horsing Around
rows.effect: If you moved a knight last move, you can't move a knight this move.

rows.name: Right Handed
rows.effect: You can't move to the a-file.

rows.name: Separation Anxiety
rows.effect: Pawns adjacent to your king can't move away from him.

rows.name: Soft Paws
rows.effect: Your knights can't capture pawns.

rows.name: Teetotaler
rows.effect: You can't capture rooks.

rows.name: Untitled duck nerf
rows.effect: A duck occupies one random square (shown on the board) all game. No piece may land on it and sliding pieces can't pass through it, but knights may still leap over it.

rows.name: Edge-Shy Queen
rows.effect: Your queen can't move onto the a-file or the h-file.

rows.name: Moonlit King
rows.effect: Your king can only move to dark squares.

rows.name: No Takebacks
rows.effect: You can't move a piece to the exact square your last move started from.

rows.name: Wallflower
rows.effect: Your rooks can't move onto the four center squares (d4, d5, e4, e5).

rows.name: Advancing Faith
rows.effect: Your bishops must gain ground on every move: each bishop move has to advance toward the enemy, never staying level and never falling back.

rows.name: Battle Fatigue
rows.effect: After a piece captures, it can't capture again until it makes a non-capturing move.

rows.name: Cavalry Charge
rows.effect: Your knights can't move backward toward your own side.

rows.name: Clergy
rows.effect: Your bishops can't move backward toward your own side; each bishop move must stay level or advance toward the enemy.

rows.name: Columnar Rooks
rows.effect: Your rooks glide any distance up and down a file, but can only shuffle one square at a time sideways along a rank.

rows.name: Cramped Rooks
rows.effect: Your rooks can't move more than 4 squares.

rows.name: Greedy
rows.effect: You can't capture a lesser piece when a higher-value capture is on the table. You may still play a quiet move.

rows.name: Just Passing Through
rows.effect: Can't capture on a random rank.

rows.name: Knights Abroad
rows.effect: Once one of your knights crosses into the enemy half, it can't come back to your own half.

rows.name: Merciful Queen
rows.effect: Your queen won't cut down the common soldiers: she can't capture pawns.

rows.name: Monastic Vows
rows.effect: Your bishops can't capture.

rows.name: Clean Hands
rows.effect: Your king can't capture anything.

rows.name: Cold Trail
rows.effect: You can't move any piece onto the square your opponent's last move just left.

rows.name: Minor Nobility
rows.effect: Your pawns can only promote to knights or bishops, never to queens or rooks.

rows.name: Rusty Hinges
rows.effect: You can only castle during your first ten moves. From your 11th move on, the castle gate is rusted shut.

rows.name: Orthodox King
rows.effect: Your king can only move horizontally or vertically, never diagonally.

rows.name: Pawn Ceiling
rows.effect: Your pawns can't move past the middle of the board.

rows.name: Prima Donna
rows.effect: Can't have more than one pawn on the same file.

rows.name: Professional Courtesy
rows.effect: Non-pawn pieces can't capture pieces of their own type.

rows.name: Queen Bee
rows.effect: Once you capture with your queen, you can no longer move queens.

rows.name: Queen Disguise
rows.effect: Your queen is secretly either a rook or a bishop. Once you move it like one, you can't move it like the other.

rows.name: Queen Fatigue
rows.effect: You lose if you move your queen more than 12 times.

rows.name: Rook Buddies
rows.effect: Your rooks can't move while any piece sits between them on your home rank; clear the back rank between them first.

rows.name: Rusty Knights
rows.effect: Knights can only move once every other turn.

rows.name: Sacred File
rows.effect: A random file is sacred. You can't capture on it.

rows.name: Separation of Church and State
rows.effect: Can't move bishops next to a king and can't move king next to a bishop.

rows.name: Shadow Queen
rows.effect: Your queen can only move to dark squares.

rows.name: Skittish
rows.effect: While in check, you must move your king.

rows.name: Sleepy King
rows.effect: Your king can only move when in check.

rows.name: Truant
rows.effect: You can't move the same piece twice in a row.

rows.name: True Gentleman
rows.effect: You can't capture queens.

rows.name: Vegan
rows.effect: You can't capture knights.

rows.name: Gentle Giant
rows.effect: Your queen can't capture pawns.

rows.name: Knight Toll
rows.effect: You can't capture with a knight if a knight of yours captured on your previous turn.

rows.name: No Going Home
rows.effect: Your non-pawn pieces can't move back onto your own back rank.

rows.name: Sabbath
rows.effect: On every 7th turn of yours, you can't capture.

rows.name: Artillery
rows.effect: Rooks must capture at distance ≥ 4.

rows.name: Blinded by the Sun
rows.effect: Can't end turn attacking a random square.

rows.name: Carnivore Bishops
rows.effect: Your bishops can only move when they capture.

rows.name: Cautious Cavalry
rows.effect: Your knights can't cross into the enemy half of the board.

rows.name: Comfort Zone
rows.effect: If you can move to a random square X, you must.

rows.name: Conscientious Objectors
rows.effect: Your pawns can't capture.

rows.name: Court Martial
rows.effect: A piece that's attacked at turn start can't capture.

rows.name: Crossing the Rubicon
rows.effect: Once a piece crosses to the opponent's half, it can't return.

rows.name: Diplomatic Immunity
rows.effect: Can't capture a piece that just moved, unless that move was a capture.

rows.name: Elephants Fear Mice
rows.effect: Your non-pawn pieces can't capture pawns.

rows.name: Entrenched
rows.effect: Rooks can't move more than 2 squares.

rows.name: Evil Twin
rows.effect: If you can capture a piece with a same-type piece, you must.

rows.name: Famine
rows.effect: After move 15, you can't capture pawns.

rows.name: Femme Fatale
rows.effect: You can only capture the enemy king with your queen.

rows.name: Goldfish
rows.effect: You can't move a piece you moved 3 turns ago.

rows.name: Half a Queen
rows.effect: Your queen can only move like a rook, never diagonally.

rows.name: Haunted
rows.effect: Can't move to a square where you've previously captured.

rows.name: Heavy Boots
rows.effect: All non-pawn moves are distance ≤ 3.

rows.name: Hipster
rows.effect: You can't move the same piece type as your opponent's last move.

rows.name: Horse Tranquilizer
rows.effect: Your knights can't capture.

rows.name: Ichthyophobe
rows.effect: Each turn you can't play the move a simple greedy engine would pick (its single best move by a one ply look: the most valuable safe capture, or a basic developing move when there is no capture). Every other legal move is fine; if that one move is your only legal move, you may still play it.

rows.name: Knight Parade
rows.effect: You must move each knight at least once before moving the same knight twice.

rows.name: No Free Lunch
rows.effect: No even trades: you can't capture a piece worth exactly as much as the piece making the capture.

rows.name: No Retreat
rows.effect: Your king can't step backward toward your own back rank.

rows.name: No Shuffling
rows.effect: Your rooks can't move sideways.

rows.name: One Bite at a Time
rows.effect: After a capture, you can't capture again for two of your turns.

rows.name: One Way Bishops
rows.effect: Your bishops can't retreat on a quiet move, but they may still strike backward: a bishop may only lose rank when the move is a capture.

rows.name: Out of Breath
rows.effect: You can only move your king once the entire game.

rows.name: Outflanked
rows.effect: You can't capture on the rim. The enemy king is fair game anywhere.

rows.name: Overzealous
rows.effect: You lose if you capture more than 10 enemy pieces.

rows.name: Pawn Duty
rows.effect: Every third turn, you must move a pawn.

rows.name: Peons First
rows.effect: Can't move pieces that are one square behind one of your pawns.

rows.name: Promotion Phobia
rows.effect: Your pawns can't promote. They get stuck on the back rank.

rows.name: Protected Pawns
rows.effect: Can only move pawns to defended squares.

rows.name: Pull of the Center
rows.effect: Your pawns can only capture toward the center files.

rows.name: Punching Down
rows.effect: Pieces can't capture pieces worth more than themselves.

rows.name: Remorseful
rows.effect: Can't capture twice in a row.

rows.name: Royal Guard
rows.effect: Your non-king pieces that are adjacent to your king at the start of your turn can't move. The king itself may still move.

rows.name: Royal Jubilee
rows.effect: Whenever you capture a non-pawn, you must move your king or queen on the next move.

rows.name: Shellshocked
rows.effect: When opponent captures, pieces adjacent to the captured square can't move next turn.

rows.name: Sibling Rivalry
rows.effect: Can't move a piece adjacent to an opponent's piece of same type.

rows.name: Sidewinder
rows.effect: Your rooks can only move horizontally along ranks, never up or down files.

rows.name: Simplifier
rows.effect: If you can capture with an equal- or lesser-value piece, you must.

rows.name: Snipers
rows.effect: Bishops can only capture from distance ≥ 4.

rows.name: Spice of Life
rows.effect: You can't move the same piece type twice in a row.

rows.name: Stir Crazy
rows.effect: If you haven't moved your king for 4 turns, you must on the 5th.

rows.name: Stop Stalling
rows.effect: Your pieces can't move laterally.

rows.name: Superstitious
rows.effect: Can't move to a square where opponent has captured.

rows.name: Three Check
rows.effect: If you have been checked three times total, you lose.

rows.name: Timid
rows.effect: Your pieces can't capture an enemy worth more than the capturing piece, unless that capturing piece is itself under enemy attack.

rows.name: Trophy Wife
rows.effect: Your queen can't capture.

rows.name: Vertigo
rows.effect: Can't move a piece more than 2 ranks in one move.

rows.name: Whites of Their Eyes
rows.effect: You can only capture within 2 squares (king-steps) of the capturing piece.

rows.name: Flinch
rows.effect: While your king is in check, you can't capture; you have to get out another way.

rows.name: Lonely King
rows.effect: Your king can't move to a square adjacent to one of your own pieces.

rows.name: Pawn Shy
rows.effect: You can't move any piece onto a square guarded by an enemy pawn.

rows.name: Short Queen
rows.effect: Your queen can't move more than 4 squares in a single move.

rows.name: Slow Burn
rows.effect: You can't capture anything before your 6th move.

rows.name: Slow Start
rows.effect: For your first 6 moves, you can only move pawns and knights.

rows.name: Stampede
rows.effect: If you moved a knight on your last turn, you must move a knight again this turn (if you can).

rows.name: Active Volcano
rows.effect: Can't move onto or orthogonally adjacent to a random square.

rows.name: Alternator
rows.effect: You must alternate pawn moves and non-pawn moves.

rows.name: Barbarian Rage
rows.effect: If you captured last move, you must capture this move if able.

rows.name: Bipartisanship
rows.effect: Can't move left twice in a row or right twice in a row.

rows.name: Bishop Fan Club
rows.effect: Must promote to bishops. King and queen can only move diagonally.

rows.name: Bishop Tunnel Vision
rows.effect: Your bishops can't move more than three squares in a single move.

rows.name: Castle Curfew
rows.effect: You lose if you have not castled by your 20th move.

rows.name: Champing at the Bit
rows.effect: All pawn moves must be distance 2.

rows.name: Chivalry
rows.effect: Can only capture heavies (rooks, queens) with a knight.

rows.name: Control Center
rows.effect: Non-capturing moves must go to files c, d, e, or f.

rows.name: Court Jester
rows.effect: Your queen can only move like a knight.

rows.name: Doctor Octopus
rows.effect: Can only capture non-king pieces 8 times total.

rows.name: Eat Your Vegetables
rows.effect: Can't capture non-pawns until opponent has ≤ 4 pawns remaining.

rows.name: Even Keeled
rows.effect: Can only capture on even-numbered moves.

rows.name: Fair Fight
rows.effect: You can't capture a piece worth less than the piece making the capture; no bullying weaker pieces, only equal or stronger prey.

rows.name: Far Sighted
rows.effect: You can't capture a piece standing right next to the capturing piece; captures must reach at least 2 squares away.

rows.name: Frozen Cavalry
rows.effect: From your 18th move on, you can't move your knights.

rows.name: Gambler
rows.effect: Can't move a specific piece type, re-randomized each turn.

rows.name: Get Down Mr. President
rows.effect: Can't move your king while in check.

rows.name: Honey Trap
rows.effect: Your queen can't move unless she is currently under attack by an enemy piece.

rows.name: Hungry Pawns
rows.effect: Whenever one of your pawns can capture, you must make a capture with a pawn.

rows.name: Inside the Lines
rows.effect: You can't move ONTO the rim. Pieces already on the rim may stay there.

rows.name: Ivory Tower
rows.effect: You lose if any opponent piece is adjacent to your king.

rows.name: Kingfisher
rows.effect: When your king can capture, it must dive for the richest prize: it has to take the most valuable enemy piece within its reach.

rows.name: Ladies First
rows.effect: Can only move king if you moved queen on previous turn.

rows.name: Leading the Charge
rows.effect: As long as you have a knight, non-knights can't be ahead of your most advanced knight.

rows.name: Left for Dead
rows.effect: Can only capture leftward (file decreasing).

rows.name: Messy Divorce
rows.effect: Pieces can't move from queenside to kingside or vice versa.

rows.name: Moving Day
rows.effect: After turn 20, no piece may be on your home row.

rows.name: No Retreat Rooks
rows.effect: From your 10th move on, your rooks can't move toward your own back rank.

rows.name: Oddball
rows.effect: Can only capture on odd-numbered moves.

rows.name: Pack Mentality
rows.effect: Pieces must move to squares adjacent to another of your pieces.

rows.name: Pacman
rows.effect: If you can capture a pawn, you must.

rows.name: Phobia of Edges
rows.effect: If a piece is on the rim, it must move.

rows.name: Power Cells
rows.effect: Can't move a piece farther than the number of pawns you have.

rows.name: Prince Charming
rows.effect: If your queen is attacked, must move a knight if possible.

rows.name: Quarantine
rows.effect: You can't move a piece into your own first two ranks from outside them (pieces already on those ranks may still move within them). Separately, while your king is in check, only your king may move.

rows.name: Queen Grounded
rows.effect: From your 12th move on, your queen can't move into the opponent's half of the board.

rows.name: Quicksand
rows.effect: The 4th and 5th ranks are quicksand. If one of your pieces lands on the same 4th or 5th rank square for the second time in the game (tracing that piece's own path, not necessarily on consecutive moves), it is stuck and can never move from that square again.

rows.name: Rook Fan Club
rows.effect: Must promote to rooks. King/queen can't move diagonally.

rows.name: Rooks Charge
rows.effect: Your rooks can only move straight forward toward the enemy, never sideways or backward.

rows.name: Royal Bloodlust
rows.effect: The turn after your king captures, you must make a capture with any piece if you can.

rows.name: Scholarship
rows.effect: You can only move a piece type after the opponent has moved it once.

rows.name: Scouting Ahead
rows.effect: As long as you have a pawn, non-pawns can't go ahead of your most advanced pawn.

rows.name: Shapeshifter
rows.effect: Queen starts as a bishop. When you capture a non-pawn, queen becomes a copy of that piece. Capturing a knight freezes her.

rows.name: Simp
rows.effect: You lose if you have no queen.

rows.name: Social Distancing
rows.effect: Can't make non-capturing moves to squares adjacent to opponent pieces.

rows.name: Solar Flare
rows.effect: You can only capture on light squares.

rows.name: Stay-at-Home Mom
rows.effect: Your queen can only move within your two home ranks.

rows.name: Sunrise
rows.effect: On odd turns you must move forward; on even turns you may move freely.

rows.name: Switchback
rows.effect: You can't move in the exact same direction (same file and rank step) twice in a row.

rows.name: Thinning Ranks
rows.effect: You lose if you are ever left with fewer than three pawns.

rows.name: Torpedoes
rows.effect: If you made a non-capturing pawn move last turn and can move it again, you must.

rows.name: Tripwire
rows.effect: A random rank is a tripwire. You can't cross it backwards.

rows.name: Turn the Other Cheek
rows.effect: Can't recapture.

rows.name: Vampiric
rows.effect: You can only capture on dark squares.

rows.name: War of Attrition
rows.effect: You lose if you ever make more than twelve non-capturing moves in a row.

rows.name: Warlord
rows.effect: From turn 12 onward, your king can't be on your first two ranks.

rows.name: Winds of Fate
rows.effect: Each turn, randomly can't move left or can't move right.

rows.name: Windup Toys
rows.effect: After move 12, can't move knights or bishops.

rows.name: Curfew
rows.effect: After your 25th move, you can't move any piece into the enemy half (relative ranks 5 to 8).

rows.name: Glass Jaw
rows.effect: You can't make a move that leaves your queen attacked by the enemy.

rows.name: Quarantine Zone
rows.effect: A random 2x2 block of squares is sealed off at game start; you can't move any piece onto it.

rows.name: Shifting Sands
rows.effect: Each turn, a random file is closed; you can't move any piece onto it this turn.

rows.name: Tax Season
rows.effect: Every 6th turn of yours, if you can capture, you must.

rows.name: Weigh Station
rows.effect: Your rooks and queen can't cross into the enemy half (relative ranks 5 to 8).

rows.name: Blood Quota
rows.effect: You may make only six captures all game; you lose if you make a seventh.

rows.name: Cheerleaders
rows.effect: Non-pawns can only capture if adjacent to one of your pawns.

rows.name: Colorblind
rows.effect: Can't move to one random color of squares, re-randomized each turn.

rows.name: Counting Sheep
rows.effect: Once you've moved a piece type 5 times, you can't move it again.

rows.name: Covering Fire
rows.effect: Can only capture a piece if you can capture it two different ways.

rows.name: Cowering in Fear
rows.effect: Can't move a piece of less value than one opponent has captured from you.

rows.name: Crenellations
rows.effect: Pawns can only move to a random color of squares.

rows.name: Crusade
rows.effect: For 4 moves starting on a random move, must end turn on a specific random square.

rows.name: Defanged Queen
rows.effect: Your queen can't capture and can't give check.

rows.name: Drag
rows.effect: Your queen is now royal: if it is captured, you lose.

rows.name: Eye for an Eye
rows.effect: If opponent captures, you must capture next turn or lose.

rows.name: Eye of Sauron
rows.effect: As long as you have a rook, non-pawns can't go past the rook's farthest sight.

rows.name: Flatterer
rows.effect: If opponent moves a pawn, you must move a pawn. Same for non-pawns.

rows.name: Forward March
rows.effect: You can't move backward.

rows.name: Fresh Faces
rows.effect: Each turn, you must move a piece that hasn't moved yet, until none remain.

rows.name: Guerilla Tactics
rows.effect: After a capturing move, you must return the capturing piece to its previous square if possible.

rows.name: Hedonic Treadmill
rows.effect: Must move a piece at least as valuable as opponent's last moved piece.

rows.name: Hobbled Knights
rows.effect: Your knights can't advance toward the enemy side; their rank may never increase.

rows.name: Homebound Pawns
rows.effect: Your pawns can't advance past the halfway line unless the move is a capture; only by force can they cross into enemy soil.

rows.name: Hopscotch
rows.effect: Must alternate light/dark destination squares.

rows.name: Horse Eats First
rows.effect: As long as you have a knight, you can only capture with knights.

rows.name: Indecisive
rows.effect: Pieces can't capture if they have multiple possible capture moves.

rows.name: Irresistible
rows.effect: If you can move a piece adjacent to opponent's king (that isn't already), you must.

rows.name: Jumpy
rows.effect: When possible, must move an attacked piece.

rows.name: Lame Duck
rows.effect: You can't move your king at all.

rows.name: Lethal Attraction
rows.effect: Can't make moves that move a piece farther from opponent's king than it started.

rows.name: Magnetic Kings
rows.effect: When you move your king, it must not end up farther from the enemy king than it started (equal distance is allowed). Moving any other piece is unrestricted.

rows.name: Medusa
rows.effect: Pieces attacked by opponent's queen are stone; they cannot move.

rows.name: Mirror March
rows.effect: Your move must go the same file direction (left or right) as your opponent's last move.

rows.name: Myopic Bishops
rows.effect: Your bishops can't move more than two squares.

rows.name: No Man's Land
rows.effect: You can't move any piece onto a square your opponent currently attacks.

rows.name: No Retreat Ever
rows.effect: Every move you make must advance toward the enemy; no piece may move backward or even hold its rank.

rows.name: Pawn Storm
rows.effect: If your last move wasn't a pawn move, you must move a pawn (if possible).

rows.name: Pawns Do the Dirty Work
rows.effect: Only your pawns may capture; none of your other pieces can capture.

rows.name: Reconnaissance
rows.effect: Start unable to capture. After seeing each opponent piece type move, you may capture that type.

rows.name: Relay Race
rows.effect: If you can move a piece adjacent to your last move's destination, you must.

rows.name: Respectful
rows.effect: You can't end your turn giving check.

rows.name: Restless Crown
rows.effect: Your king may move only six times all game; you lose on his seventh move.

rows.name: Rising Water
rows.effect: Every 10 of your turns, water rises one rank from your back rank. You can't move underwater pieces or to underwater squares.

rows.name: Rook on the Seventh
rows.effect: By move 15, you must have a rook on your 7th rank.

rows.name: Royal Berth
rows.effect: Can't place a piece adjacent to your king.

rows.name: Savior Complex
rows.effect: When in check, must move your queen, or lose.

rows.name: Scorched Earth
rows.effect: You can't move to a square you've previously moved FROM.

rows.name: Simon Says
rows.effect: Must move onto same color square as opponent's last move.

rows.name: Spread Out
rows.effect: Can't move a non-pawn adjacent to another of your non-pawns. Can't castle.

rows.name: Stand Your Ground
rows.effect: Pieces can only capture if attacked.

rows.name: Stunted Rooks
rows.effect: Your rooks can only move one square at a time.

rows.name: Theocracy
rows.effect: On odd/even moves, can only capture with bishops.

rows.name: Tidy Desk
rows.effect: By move 25, you must have at least one piece on each rank of your half.

rows.name: Torchlight
rows.effect: Non-pawns can only move if start or end square is adjacent to one of your pawns.

rows.name: Tower Defense
rows.effect: Can't move rooks. If you lose all rooks, you lose.

rows.name: Triple Play
rows.effect: Can only capture the enemy king if you have 3 of a random piece type.

rows.name: True Love
rows.effect: King and queen can only move to squares adjacent to each other.

rows.name: Unspooling
rows.effect: Total move distance budget = 100. When you run out, you lose.

rows.name: Bodyguard
rows.effect: You lose if your king ever has no friendly piece adjacent to it (after your first move).

rows.name: Bottom Feeder
rows.effect: You can only capture pawns. You can't capture any other piece, except the enemy king to win.

rows.name: Follow the Leader
rows.effect: You must move a piece onto the same file as your opponent's last move's destination, if you can.

rows.name: Gravity
rows.effect: None of your pieces may move more than two ranks ahead of your own king.

rows.name: Meteor Shower
rows.effect: Each turn, five random squares are struck and sealed; you can't move any piece onto them this turn.

rows.name: Mimicry
rows.effect: You must move the same piece type as your opponent's last move, if you can.

rows.name: You Best Not Miss
rows.effect: If you end your turn giving check, you must capture the king next turn or lose.

rows.name: Absolution
rows.effect: After a non-bishop captures, it must start a turn adjacent to a bishop before it can capture again.

rows.name: Anchored Rooks
rows.effect: Your rooks may never leave your back rank.

rows.name: Armory
rows.effect: Your rooks must stay defended at all times.

rows.name: Ascetic
rows.effect: You can capture at most one piece per piece type.

rows.name: Bloodthirsty
rows.effect: After turn 3, if you go 2 turns without capturing, you must capture if able.

rows.name: Boxing with Shadow
rows.effect: When opponent moves, if you can move to the square they vacated, you must.

rows.name: Bridge Over Troubled Water
rows.effect: A river runs through the middle. Cross only via the center files.

rows.name: Burning Bridges
rows.effect: Your bishops, rooks, and queen can't travel over a square they have already passed over earlier in the game.

rows.name: Caged Queen
rows.effect: Your queen may never leave your own back rank.

rows.name: Centralized Command
rows.effect: Can only capture if you moved your king in last 3 turns.

rows.name: Checkers
rows.effect: Must capture if able.

rows.name: Closed Book
rows.effect: You lose if two or more files ever have none of your pawns on them.

rows.name: Constriction
rows.effect: Every 6 of your turns, the playable board loses a rank from the back, up to 3 ranks.

rows.name: Devil on Your Shoulder
rows.effect: Each turn the devil suggests a bad move. Ignore him 7 turns in a row and on the 8th you must obey.

rows.name: Domino
rows.effect: Each move must end adjacent to your previous move's destination.

rows.name: Echo Chamber
rows.effect: You must move to the same rank as your last move's destination.

rows.name: Exclusivity Clause
rows.effect: Can't move to squares more than one of your pieces can move to.

rows.name: Feast or Famine
rows.effect: You lose if twelve of your turns pass in a row without you capturing anything.

rows.name: Fog of War
rows.effect: You can't see opponent's pieces (except when capturing, captures, or check).

rows.name: Friendly Fire
rows.effect: Can only move to squares defended by another of your pieces.

rows.name: Going the Distance
rows.effect: Must move at least as far as opponent's last move, if able.

rows.name: Hand and Brainless
rows.effect: Each turn, a random piece type. You must move that type if possible.

rows.name: Helicopter Parent
rows.effect: You lose if you end one of your turns with a pawn that is attacked and undefended.

rows.name: Homeland Security
rows.effect: If opponent enters your two home ranks, you lose.

rows.name: Icy Squares
rows.effect: After you move a piece, it must slide once more in the same direction on your next move (if possible). Forced slides don't force another.

rows.name: Inching Forward
rows.effect: After turn 6, king must be in front of home rank. Required rank advances every 6 turns, up to your 7th rank.

rows.name: Iron Curtain
rows.effect: You can't move any piece onto the central 16 squares (files c through f, ranks 3 through 6).

rows.name: King of the Hill
rows.effect: After your first move, you lose unless one of your pieces sits on d4, d5, e4, or e5.

rows.name: Leaps and Bounds
rows.effect: Every move must be a leap: a piece can't move to a square adjacent to the square it's leaving.

rows.name: Left to Right
rows.effect: Unless you just moved to the rightmost file, must move right of your last move's destination.

rows.name: Leveling Up
rows.effect: Can't capture a piece type until you've captured its predecessor.

rows.name: Modest
rows.effect: Lose if you have more pieces than opponent.

rows.name: Monkey See
rows.effect: Can only capture with piece types your opponent has captured with.

rows.name: No Clean Trades
rows.effect: You can't make a capture if the enemy could immediately recapture on that square.

rows.name: No Hanging Pieces
rows.effect: You can't make a move that leaves any of your pieces attacked by the enemy and undefended.

rows.name: Nurturer
rows.effect: Can't capture the enemy king until you've promoted a pawn.

rows.name: Obsession
rows.effect: Each turn, a random square. If you can move to it, you must.

rows.name: Paranoid
rows.effect: Your king must always be defended, or you lose.

rows.name: Rhythm Master
rows.effect: You must alternate captures and non-captures.

rows.name: The Scent of Blood
rows.effect: Any of your pieces that has a capture available can't make a non-capturing move; if you move that piece, it must capture. You may still move a different piece that has no capture.

rows.name: Secret Garden
rows.effect: Two random garden zones (each a 3-file-wide, 3-rank-deep block in front of one of your pawns, shown as marked squares) are off limits for the whole game: you can't move any piece onto those squares.

rows.name: Short Leash Knights
rows.effect: Your knights may never move beyond your own first three ranks.

rows.name: Siege
rows.effect: You must capture at least one enemy rook by move 20, or you lose.

rows.name: Slowpoke
rows.effect: All your moves must be distance exactly 1.

rows.name: Statue King
rows.effect: Your king can only move to capture; he can never take a quiet, non-capturing step.

rows.name: Taking Turns
rows.effect: Can't move a piece a second time until every piece of its type has moved once.

rows.name: Thunderdome
rows.effect: The center 16 squares (files c to f, ranks 3 to 6) are the thunderdome. Once one of your pieces is on those squares it can never move out of the zone for the rest of the game (it may still move within the zone). Pieces enter; pieces do not leave.

rows.name: Timid Bishops
rows.effect: Your bishops may only move toward your own side; their rank can never advance toward the enemy.

rows.name: Toothless Pawns
rows.effect: Your pawns can never capture and can never move two squares.

rows.name: Tribute
rows.effect: Every 8th turn, if you can push a pawn onto a square the enemy attacks, you must.

rows.name: Unlucky
rows.effect: Half the squares are unusable each turn, re-randomized.

rows.name: Unrequited Love
rows.effect: King can't move away from queen; queen can't move toward king.

rows.name: Vanishing Point
rows.effect: Your pieces can't move to the same square twice in the game.

rows.name: Daisy Chain
rows.effect: The piece you move must start its move adjacent to the square your last move ended on (if any such move exists).

rows.name: Deadline
rows.effect: You must capture the enemy queen by your 25th move, or you lose.

rows.name: Equalizer
rows.effect: You lose if your piece count ever differs from your opponent's by more than 3, in either direction.

rows.name: King's Leash
rows.effect: You can't move any piece to a square more than 3 king-steps from your own king.

rows.name: Regicide Clock
rows.effect: You must give check at least once every 8 of your turns, or you lose.

rows.name: Abstinence
rows.effect: If your opponent ever has two same-type non-pawns adjacent inside your half of the board, you lose.

rows.name: Always Check, It Might Be Mate
rows.effect: If you are checked, you lose.

rows.name: Boastful
rows.effect: You lose if you end one of your turns with fewer pieces than your opponent.

rows.name: Broadside Rooks
rows.effect: Your rooks glide any distance sideways along a rank, but can only inch one square at a time up or down a file.

rows.name: Cloistered Queen
rows.effect: Your queen stays cloistered and cannot move at all until you have castled.

rows.name: No Restraint
rows.effect: If you can capture you must, and if any available capture also gives check, you must make a checking capture.

rows.name: Cowardly
rows.effect: When opponent captures, you must move backward, or lose.

rows.name: Deer in the Headlights
rows.effect: You can't move pieces that are currently under attack.

rows.name: Fischer Random Endgame
rows.effect: By move 20, all your non-pawns must be on home row AND on a square they couldn't have started on.

rows.name: Fog of War (extended)
rows.effect: Hide opponent pieces entirely.

rows.name: Glorious Battle
rows.effect: On a midgame move drawn at random (you are warned two turns ahead), the battle begins: for 3 consecutive moves you must capture, or lose.

rows.name: My Kingdom for a Horse
rows.effect: If opponent captures a knight of yours, you lose.

rows.name: Noble Steed
rows.effect: Non-knight pieces can only move if adjacent to one of your knights.

rows.name: Chameleon
rows.effect: Every move must end on the same color square it started on. That means your knights can never move, your pawns can only double-step or capture, and your king and rooks step diagonally or an even number of squares.

rows.name: Grandstanding
rows.effect: Every move you make must be one of the longest available this turn: no legal move may travel farther (in king-steps) than the one you pick.

rows.name: Metronome
rows.effect: Each move must travel exactly as many squares (king-steps) as your previous move, whenever such a move exists. A knight's move always counts as two.

rows.name: Royal Entourage
rows.effect: You can only move pieces that start within two king-steps of your own king. Everything farther away stands and waits.

rows.name: Onward Only
rows.effect: From your 8th move on, none of your pieces may move backward toward your own back rank.

rows.name: Pilgrimage
rows.effect: Your king must reach the opposite back rank by move 30.

rows.name: Predatory Knights
rows.effect: Your knights can only move by capturing an enemy piece.

rows.name: Reckless Monarch
rows.effect: Whenever your king can step toward the enemy, you must move your king forward.

rows.name: Reflective
rows.effect: Non-pawns must move to squares whose mirror across the center is occupied.

rows.name: Relentless Hunter
rows.effect: You must give check on every turn you are able to.

rows.name: Retreating Bishops
rows.effect: Your bishops can only ever retreat toward your own back rank; they can never advance and never even hold their rank.

rows.name: Straight and Narrow
rows.effect: You can't make any diagonal move: your bishops are stuck, your queen moves only like a rook, and your pawns can't capture.

rows.name: Velociraptor
rows.effect: Can only capture a piece type if opponent moved that type in their last 3 moves.

rows.name: War Footing
rows.effect: You lose if you make more than 14 non-capturing moves all game.

rows.name: Glass Queen
rows.effect: You lose if you end one of your turns with your queen attacked by the enemy.

rows.name: Kingpin
rows.effect: Only your king may capture. No other piece can make a capture.

rows.name: Pin Cushion
rows.effect: You lose if you end one of your turns with two or more of your pieces (other than the king) attacked by the enemy at once.

rows.name: Royal Meridian
rows.effect: Every piece you move must land on your king's file or your king's rank.

rows.name: Bottled Lightning
rows.effect: If you can move your king, you must.

rows.name: Crippled Clergy
rows.effect: Your bishops can only move one square at a time.

rows.name: Death Wish
rows.effect: If you can move king into check, you must.

rows.name: Glass King
rows.effect: Your king is made of glass: you lose the instant he is checked while standing beyond your own first two ranks. Kept at home, he can weather a check.

rows.name: Hoarder
rows.effect: If you ever have fewer than 8 pawns, you lose the game.

rows.name: Hobbled Queen
rows.effect: Your queen can only move one square at a time, like a second king.

rows.name: Hold Them Back
rows.effect: You lose the moment any enemy pawn reaches your first three ranks.

rows.name: March or Die
rows.effect: You lose if six of your turns pass in a row without you moving a pawn.

rows.name: Neat Freak
rows.effect: After turn 10, you lose if two of your pieces of the same type (pawns aside) ever share a diagonal.

rows.name: Doomsday Clock
rows.effect: You must capture the enemy king by your 45th move. If you make your 45th move and the game is still going, you lose.

rows.name: Killing Spree
rows.effect: Once you capture, the spree begins: every one of your following turns must also capture. If you start a turn mid-spree with no capture available, you lose. Capturing the enemy king ends the spree in victory.

rows.name: Pyrrhic Victories
rows.effect: Any of your pieces that captures turns to stone and can never move again. Your king is immune to the curse.

rows.name: Shield Wall
rows.effect: Your king must always end your turn with at least one of your own pawns adjacent to him, or you lose. If the shield is broken on the opponent's turn, you get one move to restore it.

rows.name: Own Half Only
rows.effect: You can't move any piece past your own fourth rank; the enemy half of the board is off limits.

rows.name: Retrograde Knights
rows.effect: Your knights can only move backward toward your own side; a knight's rank can never advance.

rows.name: Serf Labor
rows.effect: You can only move your pawns and your king. No other piece may ever move.

rows.name: Total Pacifism
rows.effect: You can never capture an enemy piece, except the king to win.

rows.name: Wagon Train
rows.effect: Keep the column in its lane: each move must land on the same file as your previous move's destination or a file right next to it.

rows.name: The Floor Is Lava
rows.effect: Each turn, four random ranks turn to lava; you can't move a piece from or onto those ranks this turn.

rows.name: Glass Army
rows.effect: You lose the moment the opponent captures any of your non-pawn pieces (knight, bishop, rook, or queen).

rows.name: House of Cards
rows.effect: From your 6th move on, you lose if you end one of your turns with any of your pieces (other than the king) attacked and undefended.

rows.name: Perfect Defense
rows.effect: You can't make any move that leaves one of your pieces (other than the king) standing on a square the enemy attacks, even if it is defended.
